     Chini je tongmo rinai de,
     Bung reingmo chung khna ya de.

3.   Chung nang mi hing ye siya de,
     Bini kau mane nai de;
     Chini jesuh chung rinai de,
     Khathoi tangmo bai nuh thou.

4.   Kross chung bal yauh naima tong ou,
     Toung ktorr no chung khatung khe;
     Saohthaih ye chung tanglai sina,
     Tang jora sal bara ha.

title: KHRISTIAN TIKNA HINNG DI KRIMA TONG OU (KRISTIAN KAL FIMKHUR RAWH, HLAUHAWM A HNAI)
lyrics:
1.   Khristian tikna hinng di krima tong ou,
     Bo purthim wo nung tong ksungha wo le;
     Soitan chorr kting ye sole tong ou,
     Soitan no mchem ni Probu no saing di.

	Khristian tikna hinng di(3)
	Krithai sde ha.

2.    Khristian khaka hinng di kri thing yo pho,
     Nouhkha bari khe somsouh tong phuh pho;
     Nouhkha sommo bai chumoile kroihpai phi nai,
     Toikhouhnai ni thing nung tong phlai nai.

	Khristian khaka hinng di (3)
	Krithing yo pho.

3.   Khristian uaingsouhma saing di sole thing yo,
     Probu nungno reingmo tapao si di;
     Toikhouhhnain' thing nung uaingsouhma saing khe,
     Je sole thing pho kaham khe drao nai.

	Khristian juh saing phlai di (3)
	Pap sde tong ou.

4.    Khristian asa phlai di uana tong pho,
     Sorgo leinghoihthai yo nung tong mai nai;
     Probu ain' khe thing yo khakchang mai yauh nai,
     Nin' Probu khakchangmo wo hahsoing di.

	Khristian asa tong di(3)
	Uana phuh wo pho.

title: KHRISTON' THOI MOILO BAIHKHOUHMO (KRISTA THISEN HLU TAK CHHUAK CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Khrison' thoi moilo baihkhouhmo,
     Ain' khe moilo nang sei;
     Kri ye phola chamo nching ye,
     Ain' phola leinghoih ha,

	O thoikchaoh ni toi hiolkhouhmo,
	Toikhouhnaiha nching ye;
	Sorgo souh ye ang rchah yauhnai,
	O thoikchaoh thoi moilo.

2.    Brao ni pap bai obul ongmo,
     Ang tre siphlai tong ya;
     ''braon' khe Ain' Bsala thoi ha',
     Probu Isor sa ou.

3.    Ain pap no ang uaingsouhmai pho,
     Gulma tre ong si ya;
     Abo thoi bai se su pai ha,
     Hamya chaya no pho.

4.    Aini bsaoh raohya klai tong ye,
     Biadi rao gba tong pho;
     Abo thoi yo ang leinghoih khe,
     Ang khakhom ye thoi nai.

title: KHRISTO NI JUAING RAO KHATHANGHA TOI YE (KRISTIAN THALAI TE U LUNGRUAL TAKIN)
lyrics:
1.   Khristo ni juaing rao khathanghatoi ye,
     Probun' panda tang yauh nai sei;
     Buskang ni haba tangsouhmai yauh nai,
     Probu ni ha torri lai sna.

	Samung tangyauhnai chung no snam mi sei,
	Bini yauhpai chung ongmi sei;
	Abo samung no chung tangmai yauh nai,
	Probu chung no banau mi sei.

2.   Chini juaing jwo rao baluh thaih naiya,
     Purthim wo chung tongksungha ou;
     Juaing ni jora no kaham khe tang ye,
     Probu ni panda tanglai sna.

3.   Chini juaing somoing samphang ba mo dei,
     Bini ham mo kroihphi nai sei;
     Khnangphuh Probu bai toinang yauh phuh ou,
     Naithaoma khe ba phi nai sei.

4.   Sal pa ni phuh ou joto zaga wo,
     Aini phola ang rikhlai nai;
     Juaing joto rao se aini kau sanai,
     Aini samung no ma tang nai.

5.   Are ongmi se bo no ang sa ou;
     Phola bai kplung khe se tong di;
     Sal hamya phuh wo phaingpai mai yauh nai,
     Jisu ni Kross no bal lai sna.

title: KHRISTO, JUAING RAO NO REING TONG OU (KRISTIAN THALAI TE MIN KO)
lyrics:
1.   Khristo, juaing rao no reing tong ou,
     Bung se 'Soito, Kaugboi, rangma';
     Bsala keha tongmo ri khlai ye,
     Khristo, juaing rao no reing tong ou.

	Mpha, Bsala, Phola Kthar le,
	Reing ou Sorgo wo souh ya ha;
	Probu ni samung tang mai yauh nai,
	Nung bai ang sei dosa le.

2.    Bini kautma sakhouh nai le,
     Khakhomthai mai ou Bin' thing yo;
     'Apa, Apa' hing ye bung reing ou,
     Probu Nung se khoma khe s'di.

3.   Rajan' Toungktorr Sorgow' tong ou,
     Ha ni brouh Probun' man khe ye;
     Probu bai houngri yauh nai sei,
     Khristo, juaing rao no reing tong ou.

title: KHRISTO NI KHUPOR MAI MBAUH YE (KRISTA CHANCHIN MAWI KA HMUHIN)
lyrics:
1.   Khristo ni khupor mai mbauh ye,
     Khakchang ye ang rchah nai,
     Bung le aini ongmin' baoh ye;
     Khakchang ye ang rchah nai.

	Khristo ni khupor mai mbauh ye,
	Khakchang ye ang rchah nai;
	Bung le aini ongmin' baoh ye,
	Khakchang ye ang rchah nai.

2.   Khristo chin Aokchai kthorrther le,
     Chini Duari ktorrther sei;
     Chini Aokchai ktor Sorgo ni,
     Singkason wo tong ou,

3.   Bung le Isor rao ni Isor,
     Raja rao ni Raja,
     Aini khe sal pimo dei sei,
     Ang ham yauh naima sei.

4.    Khristo le aini rangma sei,
     Aini khe ye thoi ha;
     Aini panda bin thoi hiol ha,
     Ain' pap shuraomo sei.

5.    Khristo le aini rangma sei,
     Aini khakhomthaima;
     Bung se aini rangma gboi so,
     Ain' khakchangmo ni Toung.

title: KHRISTO NI THING YO DOBI YE PHAI DI (KRISTA RAWN PAN LA BOREI DUH LOVIN)
lyrics:
1.   Khristo ni thing yo dobi ye phai di,
     Probu khorang kchang nung no reing tong ou;
     Toikhouh yauhnai bai surao yauhnaima,
     Kma ya ye Bini thing do ye phai sti.

	Khorang kchang bai Bung nung no reing tong ou,
	Jisu Khristo ni khorang khna di;
	Khorang kchang bai Bung nung no reing tong ou,
	Bini thing thang yauh nai reing tong ou.

2.   Borsi kbanngma wo nung kma ye tong pho,
     Nungno naising tong khou ta baluh di;
     Bini thoi bai nung no toikhouh mi sei,
     Nung uaingsouhmo kau bai sa paimai ya.

3.   Bung khalaomo kau khoinangmo khna di,
     Pap kroiha se nini pap no ho pai ha;
     Jonom ni rangma bai khoma mai mo,
     Toikhouhmo sal wo nung no yaphaih ha.

4.    Jonom thangmo lama wo phai so di,
     Bera doka wo se hahsoing phai di;
     Bera beingnaiha nung no reing tong ou,
     Hah di jonom kma ya ye tong yauh nai.

title: KHOMA KHE DI PROBU (MIN NGAIDAM RAWH AW, LALPA MIN NGAIDAM RAWH)
lyrics:
1.   Khoma khe di, Probu khoma khe si di,
     Aini samung si ya ye ang klai tong ou;
     Saoh keha ni mangse ang choungphlai ou,
     Khoma khe di, Probu khoma khe di.

	Aini baoh ye phola gbangma rao,
	Kmapai thangha jonom mnaohma wo;
	Nini buskang wo ang tma no sa nai,
	Khoma khe di, Probu khoma khe di.

2.   Nini toikhouhmo mangna khe ang mai ha,
     Hammari gbangma Nung ang no riphlai ou;
     Maskhe aini panda wo se khoipai ha,
     Khoma khe di, Probu khoma khedi.

3.   Nung khakchangmo phola kma nai maibi mo,
     Nung ham yauhmo khupor kaham sakhouhmo;
     Tma skhe keha no pho maibi ya khou,
     Khoma khe di, Probu khoma khe di.

4.    Nung reingmo no ang khna yaye tong mai ya,
     Phola kma nai toibi yauh nai Nung tho ou;
     Phola kthar bai ang no toithe phai di,
     Nini panda aini bsaoh yaphaih ha.

title: KTHAR, KTHAR, KTHAR JEBBA KHENAI ISOR (THIANGHLIM, THIANGHLIM, THIANGHLIM ENGKIM TITHEI PATHIAN)
lyrics:
1.   Kthar, kthar, kthar jeba khenai Isor!
     Phuaing aikhe nching ye rchah baju ye man khenai
     Kthar, kthar, kthar hiaomainaiha Isor
     Isor keha - Mpha, Bsa bai Phola kthar.

2.    Kthar, Kthar,Kthar khathoinai joto rao,
     Nin singkason buskang wo tong brom nang toing ou;
     Cherub rao pho nin thing klai ye makhlum phlai ou,
     Seraph rao bai nungno brao ma khlum ou.

3.   Kthar, kthar, kthar Mnauh bai nungno kloh ye,
     Papi rao nin khomata no nuhsouh ya pho;
     Nung chouh se kthar le, tre le kthar kroi kha,
     Isor maiya souhkploungha le nung sei.

4.    Kthar, kthar, kthar jeba khenai Isor!
     Ha, Sorgo, Sumundru rao nungno man toingnai;
     Kthar, kthar, kthar hiaomainaiha Isor,
     Isor Keha - Mpha, Bsa bai Phola kthar.

title: KROSS WO THOI KCHAOH HIOL YE TONG OU (KRAWS AH CHUAN THISEN HLU A AWM)
lyrics:
1.   Kross wo thoi kchaoh hiol ye tong ou,
     Kross kthar no ang nuh mi;
     Thoi kchaoh Jisu angno phnuh mi,
     Aini khe ye hiol mo.

	O, thoi kchaoh chumari no,
	Jisu mai yauhmo ni;
	Kross wo thoi kchaoh hiol ye tong ou,
	Khathoimo bai nuh ha.

2.   Kross no Kross bari hlima no,
     Aini khe Bung bal mi;
     Uaingsouh ye Bung mai yauhmo,
     Kalbari yo rung ha.

3.   Kross hlimungma ba brekhe ong?
     Kross no ang naihoih mi;
     Ang pho khosa ni mai nai de,
     Ang saohthaihnai Kross no.

4.    Toungktorr bari bromnangma no,
     Mchemnai ni Toungktorr no;
     Sorgo wo Jisu no nuh phuh,
     Ang pho ma houng nai sei.

5.    Aini mutoi tre krai nai ya,
     Hiaothaoh ya jaga wo;
     Purthim ni angno toikhouh di,
     Khakchangmo souhri di.

title: LAMA KUARMA PHIAO TOING YAUH OU (KAWNG ZAU TAKA HAWNIN A AWM)
lyrics:
1.   Lama kuarma phiao toing yauh ou,
     Lama kpi tongthaoma sei;
     Kross pimo bai lama tongthao,
     Probu hiaomo sa phai ou.

	Chung no hiaomo bari thwu ou,
	Chini panda wo phiao ha de?
	Chini, chini,
	Chini panda de phiao.

2.   Doka joto ni khe phiao ou,
     Thang yauhnai je mai mchu nai;
     Rangnang brouh bai bikhra rao pho,
     Joto dopha ni panda.

3.   Uaingsouhmo lam phiao toing yauh ou,
     Pap no mchem ni phaing khe di;
     Bera ya ye Kross no bal di,
     Toung ktorr ri ni yachaoh ou.

4.   Ro ha wo Kross bal matong pho,
     Toina wo ang berai nai;
     Thangmo ni toungbromnang houng ye,
     Bung no chung hiao kuh nai sei.

title: LIH ONGMO KROSS SAHKA WO SE (ISUA KROSS MAK TAK CHUNGAH KHAN)
lyrics:
1.   Lih ongmo Kross sahka wo se,
     Chumari Raja thoimo no;
     Ang nuh ye lap no bera ha,
     Bakhan ongmo pho ang khoi ha.

2.   Jisu Khristo thoimo ya khe,
     Mungha no pho ang toisa ya;
     Ang hamyauhmo manoi rao no,
     Bin' samung wo se ang ri nai.

3.   Bin' bkhrouh, yauh bai yakong nai di,
     Uanamo bai hiaomo m'le ha;
     Asuh so khe gotheri ye,
     Bswu ni toung no sbo rah phi tong?

4.   Jeba se aini ong tong pho,
     Isor ni panda sto ong ya;
     Asuh so ni hiaomo kchu bai,
     Phola rangma no khatung ou.

title: MANGKHOR WO SE TONG HA (THLANAH A LO AWM TA)
lyrics:
1.   Mangkhor wo se tong ha,
     Toikhouhnai Jisu;
     Sal no naisao tong ou,
     Probu Jisu.

	Mangkhor ni Bung bahcha ha,
	Lih Samung bai stur no Bung mchem ha;
	Mchem nao gboi mangkhor ni baihkhouhnaiha sei,
	Jonom wo brouh kthar rao bai aingkhe tong nai;
	Bahcha ha. (2)
	Jisu Khristo bahcha ha.

2.   Mangna khe mangkhor wo,
     Toikhouhnai Jisu;
     Thangmo yarung phai ha,
     Probu Jisu.

3.   Thoimo no Bung mchem ha,
     Toikhouhnai Jisu;
     Thangmo lama ong ha,
     Probu Jisu.

title: MAIYA BAI RTUH KHOUHNAI AINI PROBU (HMANGAIHNA MIN ZAWNG CHHUAKTU KA LALPA)
lyrics:
1.   Maiya bai rtuh khouhnai aini Probu,
     Nini samung tang ni ang ka ya;
     Ar' pho Nin' uaingsouhmo kau saphlai yauh nai,
     Nangkhruh di sapheih yauhmo bser wo pho.

	O, bari thu ou Khristo ni maiya le,
	Ang pap brouh ni panda thoi ye thang mo le;
	Ang supai mai ya kthang tong ksungha pho,
	Toikhouhmo thoi hiolha joton' ham panda,
	Mohiman bai moilo nang so sei.

2.   Purthim brouh rao baju mai ya ong pho,
     Ang bakhan khe toi nai jething pho;
     Ha naithaomo rau se ba phai ye tong pho,
     Buskang bai hinng ye ang le tong nai sei.

3.    Kross lam wo hinng ni Khristo pal saing ou,
     Maiya nangha ni kau la ya de?
     Angle solemo bser wo pho jromsoi ye,
     Ang sakhouh phlai nai Khriston' khupor no.

title: MAIYA, MAIYA, MAIYA, MAIYA, MAIYA (HMANGAIHNA, HMANGAIHNA, LALPA HMANGAIHNA)
lyrics:
Maiya, maiya, maiya, maiya,
	Maiya Probu ni maiya takhu jonom ni maiya
	Pherao ye nung pho phai phi ja khe
	Phola thangmo jonom maiya
	Nung pho maingnai sei,
	Nungpho maingnai sei takhu
	Nungpho maingnai sei

1.    Khristo se chungno sleingni kohri ha (2)
     Are ongmi no takhu sleing taklai sti (2)

2.   Jomni duar wo ni baihkhouh phai sidi
     Baihkhouh phai sidi, Takhu baihkhouh phai sidi

3.   Sor sigol mdu bai khaye yauhmo (2)
     Nuhya mdu bai rahkhloh toing yauhmo (2)

4.    Sahso ye o nung baihkhouh phai sidi
     Khristo se chungno sleingni kohri ha
     Sleingni kohri ha takhu sleing ni kohri ha

5.    Purthimbi wo ni maiya rao le (2)
     Sahka polaha chouhni maiya sei (2)

6.   Mku khe rangzauh msing bu singyoihkhi
     Blong porboto taukula mthai dei sei
     Taukula mthai doi sei, takhu taukula doi sei.

title: MOILANGTO DESO SOIHLANG MA OU (HE KHAWVEL LUNGNGAIHNA RAMAH HIANIN)
lyrics:
1.   Moilangto deso soihlang ma ou,
     Jormo se maibi yauh ye;
     Salboi uanamo bai dukho sasti rao,
     Biaram rao bai kmam mo rao se;
     Angno ruhye ktingsa pai tong ha.

	Ang khathang wo Probu,
	Nungno ang khathang ou;
	Moitokul hakhrom mo zaga le
	O uanamo bai dukho sasti sare nang ya.
	Jisu nini khuri souhya ha le.

2.    O brephuh wo omor sal ka yauhnai,
     Jinemo par khoi souh ye;
     Maiya toi dei pipaoh mo zaga ou.
     Jala toi dei saihsa ye,
     Omor omor khe chung tong yauhnai

3.   Raja Jisu brephuh wo nung phai nai,
     Mma krui msa ni songnaroi;
     Rao naisao ye chung mkuih lau matung kha dou,
     Nin raijo kthar souhphuh le
     Omor khakchangmo bai chung tongnai.

title: MMUNG JOTO RAO NI SLAI (HMING DANG ZAWNG ZAWNG AIIN A MAWI BER LAL ISUA)
lyrics:
1.   Mmung joto rao ni slai,
     Groing tong ou Jisu ni mmung;
     Pap ni toikhouhnaiha,
     Nai di Singkason wo Bung;
     Aing khe ye tong ou.

	Khathoi ye naihoih khe,
	Khakchangmo bai maiya se ksung tong thing;
	Pal kaham rao berai nai de?

2.    Ain' phola lelaoh ye,
     Nini Raijo nuhya de?
     Nai di Zion Bsa rao,
     Jonom zaga khaohklau bai,
     Hinng pai ye tong ou.

3.   Pap mnaoh se Raijo ktorr,
     Bai Probun' mkhang kthoing tong ou;
     Boikhonto lam kro mi,
     Phola toithe di uana;
     Mo pipaoh tong pho.

title: NAIDI CHUMOI BAI SE PHAIKHLAI OU (EN RAWH CHHUM ZINGAH A LO KAL)
lyrics:
1.   Naidi chumoi bai se phaikhlai ou,
     Papnangn' panda thoinaiha;
     Brouh kthar rao Bin' loge phai ou
     Bung pai mo chumari bai.

	Halleluia, Halleluia,
	Halleluia aing khe yauh nai se phai ou.

2.   Bin' chumari samai yama,
     Joto brouh Bung no nuh nai;
     Areing areing Bung no phal nai,
     Bai mphang wo beh toing nai rao.

	Uana souh ye, Uana souh ye,
	Uana souh ye, Probu Khristo no nuh nai.

3.   Bebul ni khorang khna phuh wo,
     Ha bai nouhkha kma pai nai;
     Joto brouh Bung no si ya rao,
     Phaing khe reing yauh mo khna nai.

	Aing khe thing yo, aing khe thing yo,
	Aing khe thing yo, phaido di hing ye khna nai.

4.    Toikhouhnaiha chung no naisaomo,
     Nai di taoh le nuh yauh ha;
     Brouh kthar being ham yauh ya rao no,
     Nouhkha wo naisao tong nai.

	Halleluia, Halleluia,
	Halleluia Toikhouhmo taoh nuh yauh ha.

5.   Amen joto brouh brom toing ou,
     Singkason ni buskang wo;
     Probu chumari no la di,
     Raijo suh nini ong thou.

	Phaido sidi, Phaido sidi,
	Phaido sidi, Phaido khe chung khakchang nai.

title: NAIDI KALBARI HATHAI YO SE (NGAI TEH KALVARI TLANG KRAWS CHUNGAH)
lyrics:
1.   Naidi kalbari hathai yo se,
     Joto brouh thang yauhnai toi hiol mi;
     Abo no khathoinai rao thang nai,
     Khathoi khe thang nai.

	Khathoi khe thang nai,(2)
	Kross wo thang yauhnai toi hiolmo no;
	Khathoi khe thang nai.

2.   Nini pap joto surao pai ha,
     Toikhouhmo zaga nung souh mai nai;
     Jisu thang yauhnai doka phiao ha,
     Khathoi khe thang nai.

3.   Toikhouhnai le Sorgo phiao phai ha,
     Purthim wo chung chaya tong nai rao;
     Sorgo tongthao chungno souhri nai,
     Khathoi khe thang nai.

4.    Praing rinai le chungno toikhouh ha,
     Mnaohma wo chung chaya tongnai rao;
     Sorgo zaga chungno souhri nai,
     Khathoi khe thang nai.

title: NAIDI, THANG YAUH NAI TOI THOIKCHAOH (NGAI TEH, NUNNA TUI THISEN HLU)
lyrics:
1.   Naidi, thang yauh nai toi thoikchaoh,
     Taoh wo hiolkhouh tong ou;
     Abo toi mthangnai ni thoi sei,
     Yeing dei phuih yauh naima,

	Yeing dei phuih yauh nai toi yo toiku di,
	Je brouh toiku nai rao ni pap;
	Yeing dei khe phuih nai sei.

2.    Toikhouhnaiha Kalbari yo,
     Uana kosto mai ha;
     Abo ni baoh ye thoi hiol ha,
     Yeing dei phuih yauh naima.

3.   O, chung joto thang mainai sei,
     Abo thoikchaoh toi yo;
     Thoi moilonang no khathoi di,
     Yeing dei phuih yauh nai sei.

4.    Probu Jisu phaikhlai phuh wo,
     Bin' brouh no laphai nai;
     Thoikchaoh no khathoinai chouh se,
     Sorgo wo hah mai nai.

title: NAIHOIH SRADI CHUMOI KLOHMO BSER WO (HAN THLIR TEH U ROMEI ZAM KARAH KHIAN)
lyrics:
1.   Naihoih sradi chumoi klohmo bser wo,
     Brao tongmo Zion hathai yo;
     Brao berai ou khathangha khe,
     Brao khathanng ya hakhrommo purthim no.

	Pao mi sal kroi chung ma kah ou,
	Probun' ha khathanng ye;
	Brao berai ou khathangha khe,
	Baju ye Probu no.

2.    Chung no khathanng ya ye zaga kthar wo,
     Pherao ni choung ya hinng tong ou;
     Bo bobe kamcham zaga no,
     Braon' jug lai ye thanng pai ha luli rao.

3.   Jwo souhphai yauh nai ang mkoih lausouh ha,
     Boikhonto souhri toinanng nai;
     Luli rao bai kaohlai ya ye,
     Jonom khum kaing ye Rai no baju nai.

title: NAIHOIH YE TONG KHE (HAN THLIR ILANGIN)
lyrics:
1.   Naihoih ye tong khe,
     Kalbari yo thoimo zaga no;
     Purthim toikhouhnai Probu Jisu le,
     Uana ye, phola kmam ye Bung tong ou.

	Bung hing yauh nai no ang le nai raoh ya,
	Juda usom rao bai stur rao bser wo;
	Aini pap ni khe Probu Jisu no.

2.   O, Nini hiaomo,
     Uanamo bai se Kalbari yo;
     Chung no toikhouh ha, kma tongnai rao no,
     Aini pap shumo Nini thoi kchaoh bai.

3.    Bo purthim wo chung,
     Kma ye tongmo no Bung se rtuh ha;
     Nini yaphaohkhuri ang souh ya ha,
     Toikhouhnaiha Nung no ang rtuh tong ou.

title: NINI CHUMARI SA YAUHMO (NANGMA THIL ROPUI TE AN SAWI)
NINI MOHIMA NUH YAUH NAIMA (I ROPUINA ZAWNG ZAWNG HMU TURIN)
NINI SOMOIN SNAM DI (I HUN TITHIANGHLIM LA)
lyrics:
1.   Nini somoin snam di Probu bai tong ye,
     Bungno jonom wo kchaihma khe rom ye;
     Isor Bsa bai tong ye raohya nangkhruh di,
     Bini hammari no nung mai mai yauh nai.

2.   Nini somoin snam di purthim paisa ha,
     Nin' somoin rangzauh no Jisu no ri di,
     Bung dei ongmai yauhnai Jisu no nai di,
     Nin' samung joto wo Bung dei ongyauh nai.

3.    Nini somoin snam di Probun' kau dei khe,
     Bini yauh ni bu nung tre le ta kma di;
     Uana bai khakchang phuh Bungno nung ruh di,
     Jisu no naihoih ye Bin' kau khathoi di.

4.   Nini somoin snam di nin' bkha joto pho,
     Nung jesuh choungmo bu Bini kau dei khe;
     Maiya ni kati yo nungno toinanng nai,
     Sorgo wo Bin' samung nung tang mai yauh nai.

title: NUNG HINNGMO LAMA NO CHOUNGSNAM DI (I KAWNG ZAWHLAI KHA CHHUT NGUN TEH)
lyrics:
1.   Nung hinngmo lama no choungsnam di,
     Kmamo lama krisungha ya dei;
     Kmoihkhaohmo zaga nung souhya khosning,
     Nung hinngmo lam no choungsnam phi di.

	Taoh wo nung bro wo tong?
	Bro wo nung hinngnang nai?
	Nung hinngmo ni lam no choungsnam di.

2.   Nai di kate yauhmo lama no,
     Kross bal ye nini Probu laithanngmo;
     Toikhouhnaiha no nung ruhphreh ya de?
     Nung hinngmo ni lam no choungsnam di.

3.    Bung no kaohmo bsah baluh ha,
     Bo lama wo nung khasku de thanng ma tong?
     Nungno toikhouhnai no toinang yauh thing,
     Nai di khakchang khakamo mai nai.

4.   Chini lama no naisnam na,
     Bini bkhaoh chini khaphang phiao si na,
     Kalbari bkhaoh wo yapri se si na,
     Aro chung Toikhouhnaino nuh nai.

title: NUNG JESUH HAMYA PAP BANG TONG PHO (I SUALNA ENG ANGA TAM PAWH NIMAH SE)
NUNG NO CHUNG NAISAO TONG OU (KAN NGHAK RENG CHE KAN LALBER)
NUNG TAOHMO BROUH JOTO PAP WO KLAI PAI HA (I MI SIAMTE ZAWNG ZAWNG SUALIN AN THIM E)
lyrics:
1.   Nung taohmo brouh joto pap wo klaipai ha,
     Piri di, piri di;
     Toikhouh yauh nai nangmo gbanngma klai pai ha,
     Toikhouh ye laruh di.

	Probu Nung chung no Toikhouhnaiha,
	Je zaga ni reing la di;
	Nini yaphaohkhuri klai tong thou,
	Jonom nung no brom toing ye.

2.    Nini kau saihnai brao ni panda saing ou,
     Nung srabo risi di;
     Pap khethaoh phuh Horrkundul khoisoingmon' slai,
     Probu khoma khe di.

3.   Jisun' uaingsouhmo joton' thing nuh yauh thou,
     Thoikchaoh no phnuhsi di;
     Panthor bai hathai yo hiaonai Jisu se,
     Piri di piri di.

4.    Jisun' samung sapheih ya ye tang lai na,
     Piri di piri di;
     Jonom thangmo toungbromnang chung mai ya ha,
     Saohthaih ye tang lai na.

title: O, BONGSO HING YE (AW HNAM TIIN)
lyrics:
1.   O, bongso hing ye jormo maibimo ba,
     Kangal, gorb, machaya, manung ya;
     Ong yauh nai khede Probu ba,
     Chung no jormo khenang!

2.    O, chung machaya, manungya jati rao,
     Ong pho Probu ni thing thanglai s'na;
     Machaya, manungya ong pho,
     Chari nai sei Probu le.

title: O BORSI SAISI LAIPAI THANGMO (AW KUM SANG LIAM TAWH HNA)
lyrics:
1.   O, borsi saisi laipai thangmo,
     Arpho borsi kta khumba phi ha;
     Mnusu tongthao ye khakchang rchah di,
     Probu Jisu chung no toikhouh ha,

	Naidi somoi kcham laipai thang ha,
	Ktingkhouh phai phi ha borsikta le;
	Chin' borsikcham rao lai pai thangmo,
	Probu ni thing malai phi nai sei.

2.   O, Toikhouhnai Probu Jisu,
     Chin' bkha bsing yo achai snam di;
     Borsikcham rao si mai yauh nai,
     Nin' buskang wo chung sakhouh phi nai.

3.    O, borsikcham bai O, hamthaohmo,
     Nin' buskang wo chumari tong ou;
     Chung samung tangmo khoma khe di,
     Baju nai Raja Toikhouhnai no.

title: O BRU JATI RAO (AW BRU HNAMTE U)
lyrics:
1.   O, Bru jati rao choung ye naigra di,
     Jati le kma pai thang nai ha (2)

	Jisu Khristo ni phaing no asa ye,
	Phaidi jati no khosa laisi na (2)
	La la la (4)
	Ho ho ho (4)

2.   Being le jati no maiya cha lai ye,
     Jati no toisalai pai ha (2)

3.    Being le jati ni berai dum pai ha,
     Ha nouh thir ong lai pai ha (2)

4.    Khaphang sungnaroi toisa lai pai ye,
     Jati no khosa lai si na (2)

title: O CHUNG SOITAN SLEING YO KLAI YE TONGMO (SETANA BAWIHA KAN TANG)
lyrics:
1.   O chung soitan sleing yo klai ye tongmo,
     Chini thingyo pap gba tongmo bai;
     Papni bduno taingso yauh nai,
     Chini bkha duar no phiao lai sna.

	Kau bai mang ong ya ye,
	Khaphang dauh dauh ri sna;
	Kose ye khaphang kah ye,
	Probu Isor ni chorom wo klai ye,
	Chini bkha dauh dauh ri lai sna.

2.   Khaphang khulasa bai thang sra sna,
     Chini kaingsroi rao no skoh khlai ye;
     Kaingmung ktalbai sajao lai sna,
     Chini mkha duarno phiao lai sna.

3.    Probu Isor le khorang kchang bai,
     Chin khaphang duarno touhsa tong ou;
     Chini khaphang duarno phiao ye,
     Kristo no raja chari sna.

title: O HALLELUIA! PROBU KCHUTHER NO (AW HALLELUIA LALPA ROPUI BER)
lyrics:
1.   O, Halleluia! Probu Kchuther no,
     Baju yauhmo jething kplouh thou;
     Joto jati rao ni Raja Kchuther,
     Chini khaphang wo kau saphaiphi di.

	Tuibi di kma ye thang nai rau no,
	Muhtroi thang nai no sosa phi di;
	Purthim toithenai Athugkhroi Ktorr,
	Uana kahmo ha no kara riphai di.

2.    Raja Dayud bai toithe nai Mousi,
     Athugkhroi Ktor laipai thang ha;
     Taoh wo Jisu Khristo bai phola Kthar,
     Chini Aokchai bai chini Athugkhroi.

3.   Toi bai deso Nung banaoya khosning,
     Sisouh ya Isor le nung sei;
     Sal bai Tal akhe athugkhroi rao pho,
     Nini sal wo se brao pho kara ou.

4.   Yauhmar Kchuther akhe baju yauhmo,
     Jesuh baihkyo Nini so sei;
     Purben' ching yo ai yauhmo Bera Bsa,
     Nini thoi bai deso udar ongsi thou.

title: O HIAUNAI HA ISOR SE (AW KHAWNGAIHTU PATHIANIN)
lyrics:
1.   O, hiaonai ha Isor se,
     Aini khaphang bsing yo;
     Phola rimo khakchangmung,
     Purthim gian bai choungsouh mai ya.

	Brouh sinkrung simo bai pho,
	Choungkhouh ye lamai yauh nai kroi;
	Toikhouhnaiha ni kau thumo.

2.    O, bari thuthaih kha dou,
     Purthim sinkrungn' slai pho;
     Isorn' maiya ni kau le,
     Sorgo bai Purthim kplouh pai ha.

3.   O, ang papi kmanai no,
     Bin' uaingsouhmo sal wo;
     Thangmo phola ri yauh nai,
     Ain' praing Probu no baju di.

title: O ISOR NUNG SE KTORRTHER LE (AW PATHIAN NANG LALBER I NI)
lyrics:
1.   O. Isor, Nung se ktorrther le,
     Chin' bkha no nung nai ou;
     Jeba chung choung ye chahmo rao,
     Nung se nuh phlai tong ou.

2.   Nung le muhtroi thanng yaha sei,
     Chung no mruh phlai tong ou;
     Chin' bkha no kaham khe snam di,
     Probu Jisu'n ni baoh ye.

3.   Nin' kau dei khe chung tong mchu ou,
     Nin' kau thang yauh naima;
     Abin' baoh chung no tapao di,
     Chung le Nin' brouh rao sei.

title: O ISOR NUNG KHALAU NAI (AW PATHIAN NANG NGILNEI BER)
O JATI RAO (AW KA CHIPUITE U)
lyrics:
O jati rao, O jati rao,
	Nini bagra le nungno reing ou,
	Nini samung no yauhkar phai di.

1.   Bini tongthai yo toinang yauh nai,
     Nungno khalau ye naisao tong khou.

2.   Bosuh baluh ye pap wo klai ha,
     Taohnijora wo yauhkar phai di,

3.   Chaya lama no nung le romha,
     Gboi Kristo no nung le pao ha,

4.   Chini mchu song thoi ye thang ha,
     Horni kundul wo brao le klai nai.

title: O JUAING RAO BAHCHA LAI S'NA (AW THALAITE U I THO ANG U)
lyrics:
1.   O, juaing rao bahcha lai s'na
     Chung leinghoihmo baluhthaih ha;
     Haba seingwa taingsouh yauh nai,
     Isor le chung no reing tong ou.

	Bahcha s'na, tanglai s'na,
	Jwo pai ya s'ni;
	Isor reingmo no yachaoh s'na.

2.    Bung reingmo no khna ya khe,
     Chung le kma pai nai sei;
     Are ongmi bahcha sna, tang lai s'na,
     Jwo pai ya sni, Isor reingmo no yachaoh s'na

title: O JOTO PHAISRA SI DI (AW LO KAL RAWH U)
O KALBARI HATHAI YO SE (AW KALVARI THING CHUNGAH CHUAN)
lyrics:
1.   O, Kalbari hathai yo se,
     Aini khe rangsung ou;
     Jerusalem, Kanan raijo rao,
     Nrao ni raja ya de (2)

	O, ang samaiya, O, ang sarung ya,
	Bini uaingsouhmo kau no;
	Thu mo thu mo ang samai ya,
	Asuh khe ang no hiao ou.

2.   Rri ktorr suhmo pho kchih pai ha,
     Hlongthai rao pehkhao ou;
     Uaingsouh hiaonai Isor ni bkha wo,
     Bre khe so nangnang no?(2)

3.   Purthim manang mnaoh pai thang ha,
     Banglai ktor pho phai ou;
     Purthim manang kri ye khaih pai ha,
     Brouh kthar rao bahcha ha (2)

title: O KCHUSOYANG TOITHENAIHA (LALPA JEHO NANG MIN HRUAITU)
lyrics:
1.   O Kchusoyang toithenaiha,
     Zaga kthar wo souhri di;
     Ang phaing kroi, Nung nangkhruhnaiha,
     Nin' yauh phaing bai rom si di.

	Thangmo ni mai (2)
	Ang no cha ri phlai di (2)

2.    Kati toi kruh khe khuih phai di,
     Thang yauh nai toi hiolri di;
     Bo porboto wo tongksungha,
     Nung se ang no toithe di.

	Toikhouhnain' phaing (2)
	Nung se aini phaing bai phoi (2)

3.   Jordan toima ang souh phuh wo,
     Ang krimo Nung mthaoh sao di;
     Ang asamo Kanan ha wo,
     Kaham khe ye souhri di.

	Baju rchah mo(2)
	Jonom se ang rchah tong nai(2)

title: O KHRISTMAS (AW KRISMAS)
lyrics:
O, Khristmas (2)
	Ang naisao ye tongmo;
	O, Khristmas.

1.   Ang le rchahnai,
     Aini khorang hamthaohmo bai;
     Ang le sa nai,
     Halleluia O, Khristmas.

2.    Ang le baju nai,
     Aini khaphang hamyaohmo bai;
     Ang le msa nai,
     Hosana O, Khristmas.

title: O MAIYA ONGMO THU KHAUH OU (AW HMANGAIHNA AVA THUK EM)
lyrics:
1.   O, maiya ongmo thukhauh ou,
     Pap nang ther ongmo surau mono;
     Sapchamo kross aini asirbat,
     Rai ktor ther thoimo kross ain'khe ham mo.

	Ha bai sorgo aingkhe nai,
	Kross sahka toikang ye chrih ou;
	Sorgo'n ktor ther danggai yo thwumo,
	Mungha ni pho ong ya,
	Aini mbaoh wo sei.

2.   O maiya ongmo kchu khauh ou,
     Ang sa paimai ya angno hiaomo;
     Aini khorang nin mmung tor yauh nai,
     Angno hiaonai Probu nungno hiao ou.

3.   O maiya ongmo kuar khauh ou,
     Nini singkason ktor beraye;
     Purthim kosto wo Nung phai mo le,
     O lih ong khauh ou, ang sa pai mai ya.

4.   O maiya ongmo lih so sei,
     Tuke paiya angno palaomo;
     Chung dei souh yano sai khouh tongmo,
     Chung chuhya ther no pho yauhmoing la ou.

title: O MAIYA NI KAU NO SARUNG KHE (AW HMANGNAIHNA SAWITHIAM ILA)
lyrics:
1.   O, maiya ni kau no sarung khe,
     Nazaret Jisu so no;
     Asuh so khe maiya cha mi,
     Pap brouh dosa mainai no.

	O, miaya no bari lih sei,
	Hingmo ain' poto ong thou;
	O, maiya no bari lih sei,
	Toikhouhnai ni maiya le.

2.    Ain' panda prathona khe ou,
     Nini panda pho khe ou;
     Bini khe ye uana mi ya,
     Aini khe Bin' Thoi hiol ha.

3.    Angel rao Bung no uaingsouh ye,
     Purthim Kara ni phai ou;
     Bung uanamo khakhom yauh nai,
     Ain' pap toikhouhmo hor ou.

4.    Ain' pap uanamo toinang ou,
     Bin' panda yachauhnanng ye;
     Bin' pocha Kalbari rung ye,
     Mai yauh ye toikhouh pai ha.

5.    Bin' Chumari pusaoh thu ye,
     Bung bai ang malai phuh wo;
     Bini khaphang ni maiya no,
     Jonom krung se ma rchah nai.

title: O MANKHE DI BERA BSA NO (AW FAK RU, PATHIAN BERAM NO)
lyrics:
1.   O mankhe di, Bera bsa no,
     Kalbari yo thoi nai;
     Nung bai ang no toikhouh yauh nai,
     Bini thoi hiolkhouh ha.

	Thoi kchaoh bai thoi kchaoh bai (2)
	Toikhouh ha, Bera bsa thoi kchaoh bai;
	Toilkhouh ha, toikhouh ha (2)
	Bera bsa Hallelui baju di.

2.   O, Probu'n maiya tormo le,
     Bin' don thih ni nang ya;
     Saisi gbangma riha, ang no,
     Hammari pho ri ou.

3.   Halleluia Chumari le,
     Bung se bagra ong thou;
     Purthim pap bai ang no, Khristo,
     Thoi kchaoh bai toikhouh ha.

title: O NUNG KTORRTHER HALLELUIA (AW ROPUI BER HALLELUIA)
lyrics:
1.   O, nung ktorrther Halleluia,
     Chung man khe ou Immanuel;
     Man khemo Raja ni man le,
     Jonom wo Nini panda sei.

	Halleluia, Halleluia, Amen (2)

2.    Purthimbi ni je jati rao,
     Angel Kthar bai khabaohha khe;
     Toikhouhmo thoi kchaoh ni sal wo,
     Salem kta wo berai tong nai.

3.   O, thumo bai chumo bari,
     Nini sinrungma bai maiya;
     Phola Purthimbi ni baido,
     Sorgo ni kau bai sasouh ya.

4.    Ang no sa di bari thumo,
     Danggai bsing bai smai nangmo mphang;
     Sorgo ni Toungktorr krunglai ye,
     Ha Eden bai Salem kta pho.

title: O PHOLA KTHAR NUNG PHAI TONG DI (AW THLARAU THIANGHLIM LOKAL LA)
lyrics:
1.   O Phola kthar nung phai tong di,
     Chung no tre phaing ri di;
     Chung khathoimo bai phnuh si di,
     Abo zaga kaham (3).

2.    Kila sam wo ang tongphlai ou,
     Sal no naisao tong ye;
     Sal pi yauh nai ang ham yauh ou,
     Kalbari paimo sal (3).

3.    Purthim khakchangmo thaohphi ou,
     Tongthaomo pho thaoh ou;
     Jisu mankhemo bade le,
     Jonom khakchangmo kroi (3).

4.    Brao ni phola nung toinang mi,
     Yaphang brouh kthar rao no;
     Angno yauh to toinang si di,
     Thangmo ni lama wo (3).

5.   Bo porboto no lai thanng ni,
     Dugu kosto tong ou;
     Nung phaing kroi no khakchang ri nai,
     Toithenai phaingnang sei (3).

6.    Nung toithemo brouh rao suh le,
     Isor ni bsa rao sei;
     Lama krithing yo tuithe di,
     Uaingsouhmo phaing bai sei (3).

7.    Porboto hakraing khoinanng nai,
     Biaram bai kosto ha;
     Sorgo zaga wo mathang nai,
     Jonom tongthaoma wo (3).

title: O PROBU KCHUTHER NUNGNO CHUNGBROM TOING OU (AW LALPA CHUNGNUNGBER KAN FAK HLE A CHE)
lyrics:
1.   O, Probu kchuther Nungno chung brom toing ou,
     Isor kthang jeba khemainai le Nung sei;
     Hingsa bai sleing rao khadugu nang rao ni pal,
     Kanngal bai sungnaroi (3)
     Ni Probu Isor.

2.   Saingsamo yachaohnai Isor Nung so sei,
     Nini brouh rao nangmo saingmo riphlai ou;
     Nini bsa kahmo rangsungmo khnaphlai ou,
     Kaugboi bthai no sanai (3)
     Nung yauh kaoh khaoh ya.

3.    Akhe brouh ktor bai steh raono khnari di,
     Usom nungno chayauh ya ongnai rao no;
     Taoh wo chung pho udar ong tong mai yauh nai,
     Tma no chung kheyauh nai (3)
     Hingsi thou Amen.

4.    Jatboi mnaoh ni sleing baihkhouhnai khakchang thou,
     Kchuther wo Isor ktorrther ong tongsi thou;
     Ha wo Bung khakchangmo rao suh kthalai thou,
     Hosan, Hosana, Hosana, Hosana, Hosana, Hosana,
     Hing ye rchah si thou.

5.    Akhe je brouh n'thing yo Nini mmung torr thou,
     Nini ha tormo dei tre pho souhphai thou;
     Sorgo ni brouh khemo dei ha ni brouh pho,
     Nini murji khe thou (3)
     Nini thing Amen.

title: O PROBU NINI BAIBEL (AW LALPA I BAIBLE HI)
lyrics:
1.   O, Probu nini Baibel,
     Hammo ang choungsouh mai ya;
     Rangma ni kau soi yauhmo,
     Jonom lama phnuh naima.

	O, Baible aini rangma,
	Baibel ang thang yauh naima;
	Sorgo lama phnuh naima,
	O, Nung no ang ham yauh ou.

2.    Probun' khupor soi yauhmo,
     Kaugboi ang no phrung naima;
     Purthim lekhaboi raon' slai,
     Ang ham yauh ou, O Baibel.

3.   Khriston' rangma mai nai rao,
     Baibel no chung ham yauh s'na;
     Rangma lama phnuh naima,
     Baible Boi chongha chouh sei.

title: O SAISI GBANGMA RCHAH NAI RAO (AW MI SANG TAMTAK ZAI TE CHU)
lyrics:
1.   O, saisi gbangma rchah nai rao,
     Toikhouhnai man khe ye (2)
     Chini Isor Toikhouhnaiha,
     Uaingsouhmo man khe ye (3)

2.   O Raja ther Toikhouhnaiha,
     Chung no phaing riphlai di(2)
     Bo purthim manang sahka wo,
     Nini kau sakhouh ni (3)

3.    Probun' mmung khakhomrinaiha,
     Uanamo mthaoh naiha (2)
     Pap brouh khepho khnathao masei,
     Chung no khakhom rinai(3)

4.    Joto pap no mchem naiha sei,
     Klai nai no toikhouh ha (2)
     Bini thoi kthar chung no ri ou,
     Chung no toikhouh yauh nai (3)

title: O SORGO'N BROUH RCHAHNI KRUNG RAO (AW, VAN LENGRUAL, ZAITHIAM TE U)
lyrics:
1.   O Sorgo'n brouh rchahni krung rao,
     Toikhouhnai achaimo;
     'Ha wo kthalai sithou', hing ye,
     Nrao rchah phlai tong mya dei,
     Skangphuh khnathaoha kheye,
     Surya Raja no khri mo,
     Khaphang wo pao mai ya,
     O, khorang groingnang rao.

2.   O Nung karamo groingnangma,
     Sorgo khupor sanai;
     Haphong rangzauh toibu sariao,
     Bera rakhua tongmo,
     Hor kpal nangthaoh dei khe,
     Uaingsouh khakchangmo bai;
     Chini thing tongphlai di,
     O karamo groingnang.

3.    Maiya bai toikhouhnai ni thing,
     Toithenai a thugkhroi;
     Sorgo kchu wo berai rtuh ye,
     Nung bai malai nai de?
     Sal dei hah thang ya khou,
     Nin kara mo kroih ya;
     Chin' khe kara phai di,
     Toithenai athugkhroi.

title: O TAKHU RAO, O BUKHU RAO(UNAU TE U)
lyrics:
O takhu rao, O bukhu rao,
	Chini Raja le Jisu sei (2)

1.    naidi nai di chung puse laimo le,
     Khohsai koirom bai bura duti kloi;
     Chungno skri naima (2)

2.   Nrao Raja le kosto khenaima,
     Phola kma rinai yapri se mai ya;
     Bono berana (2)

3.   Tre raja kroi bade le,
     Bung se ktorr ther le, Kchuther ni Raja,
     Chung no toikhouhnai (2)

title: O TAKHU RAO PHAI SRA DI (UNAUTE U LOKAL RAWH U)
lyrics:
O takhu rau phai sra di,
	Sorgo tong thau thanng lai ye;
	Khahchang mo ganno rchah lai ye,
	Apa Isor bai tonglai ni.

1.   Apa Isor bade le,
     Trele chungno hiao nai kroi;
     Chung pho bono khathoi lai sna.

2.    Sorgo sahka haphong le,
     Tongthao chathao tong nai sei;
     Khna di sorgordut rao rchah mo.

3.    Bosi kta bu souhphai ha,
     Tongmung chamung slai pai ha,
     Jisu phai yauhnai sampha ha.

4.   Joto brao pho phai pai di,
     Bini mmung no la lai ye;
     Khna ye Jisu la sau nai sei.

title: O TAKHU PURTHIM SOMOING NO CHOUNG YE NAI DI (AW UNAU KHAWVEL HUN HI HAN DAWN CHING TEH)
lyrics:
1.   O takhu purthim somoing no choung nai di,
     Maiya toi dei raing ye koili bare ha;
     Jat gboin bai panji jurdo khorang chung khnamo,
     Isor Probu ni soito sampha mi sei.

	O baluh yaye dosi di Zion wo se,
	Souhphainai ha hammya bai nosto ong yauhnai;
	Nin kheye ham panda maiyauhnai no rtuh di,
	Purthim le srahha ni somoing se ong tongha.

2.    O takhu Purthim somoing no choung de nai,
     Sasao yauhmo kau rao souhphai paiye tong ha;
     Banglai ktor phai ye jurdo ktor rao souhphai ha,
     Isor Probuni soito sampha mi sei.

3.   O takhu purthim maiya pho sare ha,
     Nin tongmung akol no choungkhlai ye nai di;
     Nouhkhongha mma msa maiya sare thangmo no,
     Isor Probu ni soito sampha mi sei.

title: PAI NANNG SI THOU SLEHMO HA (RAL TAWH MAI SE LEI NINAWM HI)
lyrics:
1.   Pai nanng si thou slehmo ha,
     Pal joto kaohlaimo zaga;
     Biaram bai uanamo joto,
     Jonom khakchangmo gan wo cha thou.

	Uana gulma tre le kroi kha,
	Toikhouhnaiha tongmo zaga wo;
	Purthim gulma mai yauh ya ye,
	Jonom khakchang tong yauh nai.

2.   Chin' pal rao paimo khakchang ye,
     Zion Probu no mankhe ou;
     Ang no Jisu toikhouh min' baoh,
     Maiya ni Raijo wo toinanng di.

3.   Nai di ang daiphroi phai phinai,
     Somoi bai sal souhphai tong ha;
     Taoh wo jeba kta ong pai ha,
     Nin' Probu khakchangmo wo hah di.

title: PAL RAO SAOHKATE YE TONG PHO (THIAN TEN MIN HMUSIT MAHHSE)
lyrics:
1.   Pal rao saohkate ye tong pho,
     Aini akol Nung khakchang ou;
     Pap no noih ye Nin' thing phai ha,
     Ang khakchang nai jeba ong pho.

	Jisu bai ang malai nai sei,
	Thoimon' udar Khenaiha;
	Bo purthimbi kma ye thanng pho,
	Jisu le aini ong ha.

2.    Ang no khasaih naidi Probu,
     Ang maimi sning Nin' panda wo;
     Nung srabo rimin' baoh ye se,
     Jeba ong pho ang lore ya.

3.    Probu ni panda sei ang le,
     Kosto ong yauh naima klai pho;
     Bo no sei ang khahammo le,
     Khriston' khupor being no phrung mo.

title: PAP BAI MCHEM YAUHMO PHOLA RAO (SUAL HNEH CHHIAH HNU THLARAU TE U)
lyrics:
1.   Pap bai mchem yauhmo phola rao,
     Probun' kau khathoi khe;
     Brao no Bung leinghoih rinai sei,
     Bung khalaonaiha sei.

	Khathoi si di (2)
	Khathoi tong si di;
	Je Bungno khathoinai brouh no,
	Bung mthang ni mchu tong ou.

2.    Probu Jisu Kross wo thoi mo,
     Isor rikhlaimo sei;
     Jesuh pap pho yeing dei phuih nai,
     Bini thoi bai shu khe.

3.    Probu Jisu soito lama,
     Sorgo thanngmo lama;
     Jonom se ham yauhnai ri ou,
     Bungno khathoinaino.

4.    Sorgo khaohklau yapri se di,
     Bo dol ni logewo;
     Jonom thang yauhnai bkhaoh hinng di,
     Sorgo Mpha ni thing yo.

title: PAP NANG PAIMO AINI BKHA NO (KA THINLUNG SUAL BAWLHHLAWH HNA KHA)
lyrics:
1.   Pap nang paimo aini bkha no,
     Nin kuarenouh chari di;
     Bsing yo Probu juk tong phlai di,
     Jonom se Nung tong phlai di.

	Nung tongmo le (2)
	Jonom khakchangmo zaga.

2.    Waihasuh pho malai phi mle,
     Waiha pho malai phi khe;
     Purthim groingnangma rao ni slai,
     Naithao thaohmo le Nung sei.

	Bsaoh yaphaih nai (2)
	Nung bai pal khe tonglai ni.

3.    Roihphai pai di aini pap no,
     Aini phola toikhouh ye;
     Mnaohma wo ang tongmlu souh ha,
     Sorgo dei kara phai di.

	kara phai khe (2)
	Khakchang ye ang matong nai.

title: PAP NI POCHA BAI MLUMO NI HA NO (KA SUAL RIT TAK PHURH LEH LEI NINAWM HI)
lyrics:
1.   Pap ni pocha bai mlumo ni ha no,
     Sorgo no choung khe aro hah mchu ou;
     Sorgo tongthaoma wo pap le kroi kha,
     Braon' reingmo khorang le 'phai di' hing ou.

2.   Abo raijo chumari tongthau wo,
     Ang pap ni brouh sei bahcha mai nai de?
     Singkason kphuih chumari buskang wo,
     Aro Jisu uaingsouh ye reing tong ou.

3.    Salboi Sorgo lama no ang choung khe,
     Sal porti pap se ang no rtuh tong ou;
     Ar' pho maiya ni kau souhhphai phi ou,
     Kose ye pherao khe ham nai hing ye.

4.   Ang khnamo Probu Nini khorang sei,
     Nin' yauh sungsamo aini bkhaoh sde ha;
     Nini thoikchaoh aini panda hiol ha,
     Singkason buskang wo bahcha phai di.

5.    Hammo Probu ang Nung no khathoi ou,
     Ang khakchang rimo rao le Nini sei;
     Nung bu bwsu ni Toung ain' bu rangzauh toung,
     Nung thoimo aini khe thang yauh naima.

title: PAP SIPHAI SALBOI JURDO KHE TONG OU (SUAL SIPAI RAL NEN NITIN KA IN DO THIN)
lyrics:
1.   Pap siphai bai salboi jurdo khe tong ou,
     Thoi maimo bis bai angno kao khe;
     Ang bari leing ou,
     Jisu Bini osro angno ri phi khe,
     Pai ye ang ruhdung hoih phi mai nai.

	Hammari riphai di,
	Ang khathoimo no pap sole pho;
	Bung mchem mai ya,
	Hasmai ni hloungktorr dei phaingnang sei.

2.    Hinng di takri di pap ni phaingmar ha no,
     Bera bsa siphai no drao mai ya;
     Pap bai thoimo le,
     Chini buskang nouhkha ksom pho kroih pai ha,
     Nai di Zion sorr ktorr nuh yauh ha.

3.   Jurdo ktorr nini tarih souhphairi di,
     O Jisu, Michael no hoih di;
     Soitan no rom thou,
     Siphai rao pap mchemmo jora naisao ou,
     Gehen raja chin' pap sturn' slai.

4.    Nin' yaphaohkhuri taoh wo le souhphai ha,
     Khakchangmo kplouh thou ha bai sorgo;
     Brouh joton' thing yo,
     Pap mnaohma wo tongnai chung no toikhouh ha,
     Khathanngmo dam tongkha dou!.

title: PHAIDI CHINI BAITHANG RAO NO (KAN CHIPUITE HNENAH)
lyrics:
Phai di chini baithanng raono,
	Isor ni kau sa sna;
	Kma ye thanngnai jati rao no,
	Ho............(10)
	La...........(10)

1.    O chini juaing rao dwo ye phaipai sidi,
     Jisu se toikhouh nai ha hing ye salai sna.

2.    O chini chrai rao dwo ye phai pai sidi,
     Jisu se guboi Isor hing ye salai sna.

	Chungno mukto khe naiha,
	Jisu mankhe laina(2)
	Jisu no man khe na.

	O takhu rau bkha ka ye,
	Bo no nai ye khlum laina(2)
	Bo no nai ye khlum na.

title: PHAI DI MMUNG KAHAM BAJUNA (LO HAW RU HMINH HLU I FAK ANG)
lyrics:
1.   Phai di mmung kaham bajuna,
     Toikhouhnaiha Probu kchuther no
     Bini uaingsouhmo chini bkha bai
     Jonom wo bungno baju na.

	Mmung kaham toikhouhnai
	Bung tormo khaka bajuna
	Mmung kaham toikhouhhnai (2)
	Probu no saohthaih baju na.

2.    Bung bari hiaomo ni baoh ye
     Chung kmammo joto no Bung ri nai
     Gulma ktor bai krima cha thing yo
     Toikhouhnai chungno toithenai.

3.    Phola bai chung no srari ni
     Isor se chung no srabo rinai
     Je brouh bini mmungkthar mkhunai
     Toikhouhnaiha chung no drao nai.

4.    Phai di mmung kaham bajuna
     Chung no toikhouhnai Probu kchu no
     Bung ktormo bai bung kthar ongmo
     Chini khaphang wo tongphlai thou.

title: PHAING KROI RAO PHAINGNANG ONG NI (CHAKLO TE TAN CHAKNA CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Phaing kroi rao phaingnang ong ni,
     Gorib rao gnang ong yauhnai;
     Kana rao nuh mai yauh nai,
     Ain' Probu se toibi ha.

	Hosana, Hosana,
	Bera bsa thaihyauhnaiha;
	Hosana, Hosana,
	Jisu thoi ye bahcha ha.

2.   Pap surao mo toima wo,
     Pap surao ni ang baih nai;
     Toikhouhnai ni maiya le,
     Ain' baoh ye hiolkhouh mi sei.

3.   Pap bai kha yauhmo youh ni,
     Bin' maiya khlom ni bsing yo;
     Phiouh yauh mo ang le mai ha,
     Baju mo gan ang rchah nai.

title: PHOLA KTHAR TAUTHU AKOL KCHANG (THLARAU THIANGHLIM THURO NUNNEM)
lyrics:
1.   Phola kthar tauthu akol kchang,
     Phaikhlai phi di khathang ou;
     Sramo kta riphai phi di joto no,
     Bera ya ye pherao phai sti.

	O! chung khathang ou phola kchangha,
	Nung bai ya khe brouh rao lama kro ou;
	Toithe phi di Sorgo athugkhroi,
	Zion khakchangmo lama wo.

2.    Khna di Probu Nin' bsa rao le,
     Brao jonom lama kro ha;
     Ha bera mruhnai rao toithe mai ya,
     Brekhe chung kheyauhnai Probu?

3.    Phola kthar Nung tong thing yo le,
     Purthim uanamo rao kroi;
     pap nouhbar bai gulma stur torrphai pho,
     Nin' mmung brom toing ye ang rchah nai.

4.    Jisu akol kchang Nung phai di,
     Uanasouh ye mai yauhmo;
     Siri phi di Nini Toungmsunang bai,
     Nung krima cha ye tongmo no.

title: PHOLA KTHAR THANGYAUH NAIMA (THLARAU THIANGHLIM NUNNA BER)
PHOLA NI CHATHAI HAZAR KAHAM
lyrics:
1.   Phola ni cha thai hazar kaham,
     Malai ya bauh de ong nang;
     Bosahha somoing uo chini jati,
     Thumo siphai ya ong mo.

	Somoi bai ding uaingsouhha khe,
	Mastor ong yauhnai ongha,
	Tma hing khe abohtoi rau bai,
	Mai kpeih chanai jati rau skou.

2.    Chini mung hamnauh painji sei,
     Hing yauhmo le kau bauh ha;
     Chung kroi khaphang thuhphu yaba,
     Being ni khutoi se kchau sio.

3.    Mastor ong yauhnai khe phai di,
     Chini toi bondi rau no;
     Hiolkhouh rilai sra si na,
     Akhe phrungnai chung ongmai nai.

title: PORBOTO GULMA ZAGA WO (KA BUAINA RAM THLALERAH HIAN)
lyrics:
1.   Porboto gulma zaga wo,
     Aini Probu ang khakchangmo;
     Toi ujangna sorr snammo ou,
     Naihoih ye ang khathang tong ou.

	Sorgroingnang wo ang leinghoih nai.
	Probu tongmo sor groingnang wo;
	Ang leinghoihnai ujangna ou,
	Ang jonom khakchangmo nouh ou.

2.    Khathoinai rao tong yauhnaima,
     Probu zaga snam nai hing ou;
     Khathang nai ya purthim tongmung,
     Bung snammo sorr ang souh phuh ou.

3.    Purthim wo tongthai mai ya ye,
     Porboto wo lelaoh tong ye;
     Probu aini panda snammo,
     Ang leinghoih nai toima baih ye.

4.   Probu no baju ye rchah na,
     Bera bsa thoi ye thanngnai no;
     Jepho ang phai phi nai hing ou,
     Khakchang tong di uana nai rao.

title: PROBU ANGNO HIAOMOLE (LALPA MIN HMANGAIHNA CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Probu angno hiaomo le,
     Sorgo rangsauh no bera ye;
     Pap bsa rao no rtuh yauh nai,
     Jisu kosto mai ha.

	Uanamo Kross no aini panda bal ye,
	Leing ye klai tong ou;
	Ain' panda khil bu yauhmo shakhna dou,
	O, ang samai ya.

2.    Tongphlai ya ha beraimo,
     Rri kchaoh bai bswu ni toung houng ye;
     Dugu kosto mai yauh ye,
     Bera bsa Jisu no.

3.   Nai bore ya Jisu no,
     Pap brouh panda Kross no bal ye;
     Kalbari bkhaoh naihoih ye,
     Probu leing yauh souh ha.

4.    Aini khe ye mai yauh ye,
     Kalbari hathai Kross wo no;
     Aini pap joto ho ye,
     Toikhouh ha Jisu se.

title: PROBU ANGNO THOMO ZAGA JETHING YO PHO (LALPA, KAL TURA MIN DUHNA HMUN APIANG CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Probu ang no thomo zaga jething yo pho,
     Hathai kchu bai toima ktorr ang baih yauh nai ong pho;
     Nini Kross ni phaing bai ang no bol khe,
     Nini hiaomo kau no ang saphlai nai.

	Daidi baihkhlai si di, sal rao laipai nai ha,
	Kalbari ni toikhouhmo siya raon' thing yo;
	Nini ha ka mo jora le nini ong nai,
	Ta kri si di, saohthaih ye tang si di.

2.    Soitan ni phaing no kri ya ye yapri se di,
     Paithaoh phuh pho nini thing yo Ang tong nai sei;
     Ang nung no kau ri ha 'Ta kri si di'.
     Ta kri sid di saohthaih ye tang si di.

3.   Aini kau le pherao nai ya, thir se tong ou,
     Nung no gulma khemai nai kroi, Ang yachaoh ha.
     Nung ha ka mo jora nung no ri nai,
     Ta kri si di phaing kraohma khe tong di.

4.    Aini toikhouhmo Zion wo toibi si di,
     Brao ni panda wo leinghoihthai ang jai khe nai;
     Phaing kraohma bai kri ya ye sa phlai di,
     Khakchangmo tong ou groingnang ong nai sei.

title: PROBU BO PURTHIM MNAOHMA WO (LALPA KHAWVEL MI THIM ZINGAH)
lyrics:
1.   Probu bo purthim mnaohma wo,
     Nini pimo hoihkhlai di;
     Braon' Toikhouhnaiha ni sal wo,
     Jonom rangma mai yauh nai.

	Probu Nung karamo hoih di,
	Je zaga tongnai raon' thing;
	Nini hiaomo bai khalaomo,
	Mangna rini yachaohmo.

2.    Hor mnaoh uana tongmo ni,
     Phola kmanai toikhouh di;
     Brao ni somoi bai sal rao le,
     Thanng pai nai ha do si thou.

3.   Nung yachaohmo kau kthar so no,
     Gospel khupor no sa di;
     Nrao ni thing yo ang tongphai nai,
     Hing ye brao no sakhna di.

4.   O, mchemnai Gospel hing tong di,
     Purthim Joto zaga wo;
     Kara thou bo purthimbi yo,
     Do si di thanngpai nai ha.

title: PROBU, DAYUD BAI BINI BREM ATHUGKHROI (AW LALPA, DAVIDA LEH A THLAH ARSI)
lyrics:
1.   Probu, Dayud bai bini brem Athugkhroi,
     Nini hammo raijon' khe ang no snam di;
     Ang khakchangmo toispoung dei khe kphongsa ye,
     Thoimo toima tong ye Nung no baju nai.

	O Probu nini mmung baju rchah nai,
	Nung taohmo joto rao pho rchah thou;
	Probu baju ye khorang spla di,
	Ha manang rchahmo khorang kplouhh nai.

2.   Ang achai phai ya khosning Probu Jisu,
     Ang no Nung sukhouhha nini thoi kchaoh bai;
     Tuke pai ye mchi maimo kau ong ja m'le,
     Purthim wo rchahmo bai kplouh rini renai.

3.    Nung zaga thir khemo ba bro wo Probu?
     Daniel dei khe uang ni ching naihoih ja ni;
     Rangzauh ruhphai dei groingnangma zaga wo,
     Dugu kanda jromsoing ye naihoih ja nai.

4.    O, Immanuel snammo Boikhonto no,
     Kbeing ksong kheye berai ye ma nai mile,
     Dugu sasti kheye kauhlaimo brouh bai,
     Sorgo pusaoh thu ye chung malai phinai.

title: PROBU GANTHEMO TONG OU (CHUNG KHUANU LENG RUATSA IN)
lyrics:
1.   Probu ganthemo tong ou,
     Kailai yauh naima no;
     Takhu rao khabaohha khe,
     Abo dei lalai ha.

	Hammari bai chin' Isor sei,
	Mruh ye gbeing tong thou;
	Khakchangmo bai khathangha,
	Jonom Bin' samung tang ye;
	Maiya bdu bai kha yauhmo,
	Tre kchaih ye tongsi thou.

2.    Khatung khaphuih malaimo,
     Gbomha khe ong lai ye;
     Tongthao bai kosto wo pho,
     Pal ong ni smai tang ha.

3.    Uanamo msannglai yauh nai,
     Khakchang thing mnoilai ni;
     Thephanaiha Isor se,
     Mruhbeing phlai ye tong thou.

title: PROBU ISOR ANGNO NANGKHRUH DI (LALPA PATHIAN MIN TANPUI RAWH)
lyrics:
1.   Probu Isor angno nangkhruh di,
     Nung bai Ya khe chung thang mai ya;
     Khakhommo jaga souh mai yauh nai,
     Probu Nung se chungno toithe di.

	O, Probu Nung angno nangkhruh di,
	Nini bsa kah ye tong pai ou;
	Chin khe Nung thoimo si mai yauh nai,
	Probu taoh wo se nangkhruh di.

2.   Chin' rungmo simo rao bai le,
     Probu Nini samung tang ni mai ya;
     Probu Nung phrung phai ya khe chung le,
     Chung le rung ya Nin samung.

3.    Ang thoi ni ong tong phuh ni sal wo,
     Nung se Nini thoi bai hamri ou;
     Nung choungmo dei angno khephai di,
     Chung no nangkhruh di O, Probu.

title: PROBU JISU NANGKHRUH PHAI DI (ISU LALPA MIN TANPUI RAWH)
lyrics:
1.   Probu Jisu, nangkhruh phai di,
     Nung bai ya khe ang thang mai ya;
     Toikhouhmo gboi ang no ri di,
     Nung ang no yauhtow di.

	Probu, nangkhruh phai di,
	Probu, nangkhruh phai di;
	Khristo thoimo sakhouh yauh nai,
	Probu, nangkhruh phai di.

2.   Ang le rung ya phaing kroi ong mi,
     Nin' Thoi Kthar aini khe hiol ha;
     Nunng mchumo dei ang no snam di,
     Probu nangkhruh phai di.

3.    Ang saohkeha le tang mai ya,
     Tangni choungpho bera khoi ou;
     Ang no uaingsouh ye toikhouh di,
     Probu nangkhruh phai di.

4.   Probu nin' buskang wo kongye,
     Nin' uaingsouhmo ang saing ja ou;
     Nin samung tangsouh mai yauh nai,
     Probu nangkhruh phai di.

title: PROBU JISU NO ANG MAIMO N'CHING LE (LAL ISUA THIAN DUHAWM KA NEIH HNU HIAN)
lyrics:
1.   Probu Jisu no ang maimo n'ching le,
     Lama kchoih yo hahsoing mi se ong ha;
     Pap stur rao chumoi ksom dei kloh phai ou,
     Are pho mchem maimo le aini.

	(Ujang kul souh phoh ou)
	Jisu bai ang malai nai sei,
	(Khakchangmo kau sa nai)
	Thoimo udar khenaiha;
	Bo purthim le kma thanng pho,
	(Rangma)
	Jisu le aini ong ha.

2.    Ang tangphlaimo rao tang ni mchang si ya,
     Ang tang phlai yama tangyauh nai nang ha;
     Aini khaphang wo raja chari mi,
     Bung khatungmo dei ang tangphlai nai ha.

3.    Tma ongmi ain khaphang gulma ong nang,
     Purthimbi manoi rao ni baoh ye sei;
     Probu Jisu se pap no mchem pai ha,
     Jisu no baju yauh ye tongsi thou.

title: PROBU KHORANG KCHANG BAI (LALPA I AW NEMA MIN KOHNA CHU KA HRIA)
lyrics:
1.   Probu khorang kchang bai,
     Ang no reingmo si ou;
     Nini thoi bai ang no shu di,
     Kalbari baihkhouhmo.

	Probu ang phai ou,
	Nung no asa ye;
	Nini thoi bai surao di,
	Aini pap joto no.

2.    Aini pap joto bai,
     Nini thing yo phai pho;
     Nung se aini phaing bai rangma,
     Aini pap surao nai.

3.    Bo ha bai sorgo wo,
     Kthalaimo asamo;
     Khathoi ye hiaomo mai yauh nai,
     Jisu ang no reing ou.

4.    Brom toing di thoikchaoh no,
     Brom toing di toikhouhmo;
     Brom toing di Jisu Khristo no,
     Chini phaing bai rangma.

title: PROBU LE PHAIKHLAI PHI NAI SEI (LALPA CHU A LO KAL LEH ANG)
PROBU NI BERA MTHU RAO KMA YA YE (LALPA BERAM HOTE CHU HIM TAKIN)
lyrics:
1.   Probu ni bera mthu rao kma ya ye,
     Bera joli yo tong ou;
     Braon' bsing toikhouh paimo hathai yo kma ha,
     Rangzauh bai dum yauhmo bsing tongmo;
     Bera beingnai ni yauh wo tongmo khaih ye,
     Chapang bai bswu blung wo khaih ye thanng ha (2)

2.    Probu Nung toikhouhmo gbangma tong ou,
     Nin' panda ong ya kho dei?
     Bera beingnai sa ou ''Brao le aini sei,
     Aini thing ni khaih ye thanngmi sei''
     Lama chaya pap bsing yo tongpai phi pho,
     Bera rtuh ni porboto wo thanng nai (2)

3.   Toikhouhmo rao, Toikhouhnai no si ya,
     Toi kthuma baih thanng mo rao;
     Probu se thoimo sakhlom baihnang thanng ha,
     Lam chaya bera khorang khna ye,
     Porboto wo bera kma mo mai ye ha;
     Pap wo klai pai thanngmo no toikhouh ha (2)

4.    Blong kthuma wo khaihpai thanngnai rao,
     Hathai, hinng berai kma nai;
     Nini thoi hiolmo le brao ni khe pho nou
     Thoi bai toikhouhmo brao si ya.
     Probu nini bkha shamo laitaori ni;
     Blong ni bswu bai nung no kosto ri ha (2)

5.   Hathai kchu bai toisa mnaohma bsing yo,
     Hlong ktorma ni mser n'ching yo;
     Sorgo doka souhri khakchangmo kplouh ha,
     Khakchang di bera kma mo maiha,
     Singkason wo Angel rao bajusao ou;
     Halleluia, Probu rtuhkhouh ha (2)

title: PROBU NI KHUPOR SA NAI RAO (LALPA CHANCHINTHA HRIL TU TE)
PROBU NINI PHOLA BAI KAPHLA DI (LALPA I THLARAUVIN FANGCHHUAK LEH LA)
lyrics:
1.   Probu nini phola bai kaphla di,
     Hakhrom mo kahmo ni ha no;
     Toikhouhmo kila bsing wo tong yauhnai,
     Nini brouh no toinanng di.

	Sorgo lama toinanng di,
	Mnaoh uana mo pai nanng ye;
	Chini stur pap no chung painai sei,
	Nini pimo wo tong khe.

2.   Probu nin' phola chin' thing yo tong khe,
     Chini buskang mnaohmo kroih nai
     Purthim gulma bai dugu sahka wo,
     Chung tongnai nini ha wo.

3.    Probu toithe ya khe purthim le,
     Saisi gbangma kma mo ha sei;
     Kma ya ye zaga kthar wo souhri di,
     Probu nin phaing asa ye.

4.    Jesuh dugu jromsoing tong s'na,
     Phaing kroi no nangkhruh nai Probu;
     Phola bai chungno toinanng souhri nai,
     Jaja kthar chung souhya ha.

title: PROBU NINI SAMUNG (LALPA I HNATHAWH HI)
lyrics:
1.   Probu Nini samung,
     Nung srari phai si di;
     Kautma saihnai rao ni phaing bai,
     Purthim no toikhouh thou.

	Nin' samung srari di,
	Taoh chung Nungno saing ou;
	Probu chung bai pal tongphlai ye,
	Nung Srabo ri si di.

2.    Probu Nin' samung wo,
     Nini mmung brom mai thou;
     Beingni bkha wo Nin' uaingsouhmo,
     Nung se banngri si di.

3.    Probu Nini samung,
     Nung se Srabo ri di;
     Bari kthar ongmo ni kau no,
     Chung sisouh mai yauhnai.

4.   Probu Nin' samung wo,
     Srabo watoi ri di;
     Man ktorr le Nini panda sei,
     Chung hammari mai nai.

title: PROBU'N DON ANG KHATUNGYA (LALPA SUM KA NGAINEP A)
PROBU NINI SAMUNG TANGNI REINGMO (LALPA I RAWNGBAWLNA MIN KOH HI)
PROBU NO MANKHE DI, ISOR KRAOHHA NO (LALPA CHU CHAWIMAWI RU, PATHIAN CHAKA CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Probu no mankhe di, Isor kraohha no,
     Toikhouhmo bai chini boikhonto lama;
     Chung no sapai min' baoh Bung no mankhe di,
     Horrslai bai chumoi bsing chung no toithe ou.

	Angel rao mankhe di, nrao ni khorang bai,
	Bini muhkhang bai, being bkha no piri ou;
	Bini ha ktor ma le uar ruh uar ruh sei;
	Bin' samung joto bai (2)
	Probu no brao mankhe ou, ain' phola pho.

2.    Phola kma nai ni thing toikhouhmo ri ou,
     Pap brouh ni khe shu yauh nai toi hiolri ha;
     Bini bsa rao no maiya ongmin' baoh ye,
     Saingsamo yachaoh ou, Bung no man khe di.

3.   Probu no mankhe di Imanngkha phuh wo,
     Bin' uaingsouhmo phaing bai chung no romphai ha;
     Khathoi ye asa ye, pai thangnai rao bai,
     Maiya ni ha wo chung malai srao pai nai.

title: PROBU PHAIYA HA LE KHATHOINAI BSA RAO LE (LALPA A LO KAL HMA CHUAN RINGTUTE CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Probu phai ya ha le khathoinai bsa rao le,
     Somoi yo malai ou, somoi yo kaohlai ou;
     Takhu sormoih kthum ye malaimo din yo pho,
     Khathanng ye kaohlai yauh nai nang ou Purthim le.

	Thannglai na, O nai ye thannglai s'na,
	Tonglai di, O nairuh ye tong di;
	Kaohlai yauh nai nang ya Sorgo groingnangma wo,
	Khathanng ye kaohlaimo joto chung malai nai.

2.    Probu tongmo Sorgo Zion no khathanng ou,
     Abo Boikhonto zaga wo chung souh phuh le;
     Purthim wo khathanng ye kaohlainai joto rao,
     Chung joto souh phuh le Halleluia rchah nai.

3.    Moitokul deso wo khathanng ye kaohlai pho,
     Moitokul deso no bera ye khoi ya s'ni;
     Probu nangkhruhmo bai phortoi suhbroi souh pho,
     O takhu tapao di, nai thanng di 'mang kaham'.

title: PROBU NO MANKHE YE ANG RCHAH NAI (LALPA CHU FAKIN KA CHAWIMAWI ANG)
lyrics:
1.   Probu no man khe ye ang rchah nai,
     Ang no toikhouh min' baoh ye;
     Bini uaingsouhmo rchahmung rchah ye,
     Jonom se rchah phlai nai.

	Aini pap joto Bung sukhouh ha,
	Bini mmung bai sei(2)
	Aini pap joto Bung sukhouh ha;
	Halleluia Bin' mmung bai.

2.    Aini pap joto bai ang thanng pho,
     Bung se leinghoihthai ri ou;
     Angno toikhouh min' baoh man khe nai,
     Man khe ye rchah phlai nai.

3.    Bini thing souh khe man khekuh nai,
     Kthoi ni angno toikhouh mi;
     Man khe phlai nai jonom krungsouh ye,
     man khemo thaoh nai ya.

4.   je rtuh nai panda zaga tong ou,
     Je khatung nai phai si di;
     Khakchangsouh yauhnai toingmo tong ou,
     Khaka ye rchah lai s'na.

title: PROBU NOUHBA KRAOHMA PHAI HA (LALPA THLIPUI A TLEH CHIAM A)
PROBU SE BUNG HAMYAUH MO BROUH RAO (LALPAN A HMANGAIHTE RAM A BUATSAIH CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Probu se Bung ham yauhmo brouh raon' panda,
     Purthim Kanan ha n'slai tongthaori kuh ha;
     Bini raijo tongthaohma wo chung tong yauh nai,
     Khorang kchang bai chungno reing tong ou.

	Salboi chungno nung ou,
	Khorang kchang khna di;
	Bung hiaomo wo se phai di,
	Jordan toima pipaoh pho;
	Probu ni ha wo hahphai sidi.

2.   Aro thang yauhnai ni mphang bai siaroi no,
     Nai ye khathanng ou thangmo ni khumba rao;
     Pap shu yauh naima jonom tongthaoma zaga,
     Probu ham yauhmo rao berai mo.

3.    Aro jonom wo pi nai Probu Jisu.
     Angel rao bai khakchang rchahmo chung rchah nai;
     Khristo no nainai brouh rao pap no tre kri ye,
     Khaka ye Probu no baju na.

title: PURTHIM BAI JISU NUNG NO NANG YAUH OU (KHAWVELIN ISU A MAMAWH CHE)
lyrics:
1.   Purthim bai Jisu no nang yauh ou,
     Si ya ye saisi kbangma lai ha;
     Brao tong pai khou pap mnaohma bsing yo,
     Toikhouhnai Jisu no brao si ya.

	Purthim bai Jisu no nang yauh ou,
	Kara phai di bo purthim wo;
	Purthim pap no toikhouhnaiha,
	Nung se brao no siri phai di.

2.   Purthim bai Jisu Nung no nang ou,
     Tongmung chaya khe se tong pai khou;
     Tongthaomo bai khabaimo rao pho,
     Kloh ye tong ou bo purthimbi yo.

3.    Purthim bai Jisu Nung no nang ou,
     Raijo manang no kara yauh nai;
     Purthim bai Jisu Nung no nang ou,
     Joto brouh udar mai yauh nai ma.

4.   Chung khristian ong nai rao bsing yo pho,
     Lama kronai rao gbangma tong ou;
     Purthimno chung ham yauh min' baoh ye,
     Purthim no piri ni raoh nai sei.

title: PURTHIMBI PAP WO KLAIMO TOIKHOUH YAUH NAI (KHAWVEL SUALA BO HNU TLANCHHUAK LEH TURIN)
lyrics:
1.   Purthimbi pap wo klaimo toikhouh yauh nai,
     Isor se Bini Bsala chungno ri ha;
     Toikhouh yauhmo mai ya rao rangma maiphi yauhnai ma,
     Rikhlaimo bai samung tang yauhnai reing ou.

	Ri di akhe nrao no pho riyauh nai,
	Rimo bai Isor no mchem mai nai ya;
	Isor le brouh ni thing yo koung ya.
	Hammari yarung le Bung sei.

2.   Khathoinai rao, Isor chungno reing tong ou,
     Baihkhouh ye khupor kaham sa di hing ou;
     Baihkhouh mai ya raon' khe pho chini tang yauhnai tong ou,
     Dan ri ye samung tang di, Probu hing ou.

3.    Khathoinai rao bro wo nrao ni don rung nai,
     Phola bkhaoh wo nung rung ja khe mai nai;
     Khathoimo bai nung rimo Probu naisao ye tong ou,
     Bsah jora wo angno khathoinai hing ye.

4.   Taoh ang khna ha Probu Nung angno reingmo,
     Khristian joto missionary wo reing ou;
     Nungno ang yaphaih khaoh ha aini rangma bsaoh manang,
     Ang le Nini sei thoi angno pai mi

title: PURTHIM BERANANNG YE (KHAWVEL CHHUAHSAN ILA HNUTIANG HAWI TAWH LOVIN)
PURTHIM JALA BKHAUH BAI DE NUNGBA THANGNAI (KHAWVEL HLIMNA LAMAH)
lyrics:
1.   Purthim jala bkhauh bai de nungba thangnai,
     Khakchangmo pura mai ni ya,
     Nini kheye nosto ong yauh nai sei,
     Lachi maing pho nung mainai.

	O bongso ta baluh laisti douh,
	Purthim jwo le khum dei sei;
	Kroih ye daidi krai thanng ou,
	Kristo nthing daidi phai di douh.

2.   Nini jwo kaham sisa maimo no,
     Purthim khauh bai ta hoih di,
     Kristo niche ye nini jwo no ri di,
     Omor thoimo mai yanou.

3.   Purthim le jonom tong yauhnai zaga ya,
     Aiyu de kroih se thoi nang khe le;
     Bobe ni bazaar le paining kha dou,
     Probu nthing se thanglai sna.

title: PURTHIM KHAKCHANG YAUH NAI PHAIHA (KHAWVEL LAWM NAN A LO KAL A)
lyrics:
1.   Purthim khakchang yauh nai phai ha,
     Ha bung nokhakchang thou;
     Joto ni bkha zaga ri thou,
     Ha bai Sorgo rchah thou (2)
     Sorgo bai purthimbi rchah thou.

2.    Purthim khakchang ni aing khe ou,
     Joto baju rchah thou;
     Hathai - harung toisa toikpeih
     Khakchangmo gan rchah thou (2)
     Rchah thou brao khakchangmo ni gan.

3.   Uaingsouhmo bai Bung aing khe ou,
     Jati rao bahcha ha;
     Bin' chumari sasouh mai ya,
     Bin' maiya thu mo no (2)
     Sasouhmai ya Bin' maiya no.

title: PURTHIM KMA YE THANG PHO (KHAWVEL HI BO MAHSE)
PURTHIM MNAOHMA WO GBANNG BALUH THAIH NAI YA (SUALTHIMAH HIAN KAN VAKVAI REI TAWH LOVANG)
lyrics:
1.   Purthim mnaohma wo gbanng baluhthaih nai ya,
     Salboi jonom zaga sde ou;
     Isor karamo sorr wo ang mathang nai,
     Doka groingnangma phiao phuh wo.

	Doka groingnangma phiao phuh wo (2)
	Chini Probu bai malai ye khakchang nai;
	Doka groingnangma phiao yauh phuh.

2.    Rung bathaohthai yo chung no naisao tong ou,
     Doka groingnangma phiao phuh wo;
     Purthim pap bai khaukchoimo no ang kaoh nai,
     Doka groingnangma phiao yauh phuh.

3.   Biaram, uana, khauhchoimo tre kroi khaoh kha,
     Doka groingnangma phiao phuh wo;
     Thoi ye kaohlainai rao bai chung malai nai,
     Doka groingnangma phiao yauh phuh.

4.   Jonom nouh pimo se chung no kara nai,
     Doka groingnangma phiao yauh phuh;
     Toima ujangna wo khaka ye rchah nai,
     Doka groingnangma phiao yauh phuh.

title: PURTHIM PIRI NAIMA MAIYA (AW HMANGAIHNA KHAWVEL ENTU)
lyrics:
1.   Purthim piri naima maiya,
     Kalbari mphang ni Kross wo se;
     Probu se toibi ha,
     Choung ye naikhe moilo nang sei,
     Thoimung krisungha mai yauh ye;
     Thoi kchaoh hiolkhouh ri ha (2)

2.    Uaingsouhmon' baoh Bung mai yauh ou,
     Kosto, kekto Noroko ni;
     Chung no toikhouh phai ha,
     Bung hammon' sal wo thang yauh nai;
     Ain' phola Sorgo tong yauh nai,
     Mankhe ni mlu nai ya (2)

3.    Purthim pai phuh toikhouh yauhmo,
     Sorgo wo bkha thangha khe ye,
     Chung malai srao phi nai,
     Aro uana kahmo joto;
     Kosto, gulma rao kma pai nai,
     Toikhouhnain' buskang wo (2)

4.    Khaka mo sal souhphai nai ha,
     Probu ang no toinang phuh wo,
     Bin' muhkhang ang nuh nai,
     Ang khasouhmo Toikhouhnai no;
     Jonom hammari mai tong ye,
     Mankhe ni mlu nai ya (2)

title: PURTHIM WO CHUNG KHATHOINAI RAO BAI (KHAWVELAH HIANIN RINGTU TE HIAN)
lyrics:
1.   Purthim wo chung khathoinai rao ba,
     Tma ni dosa mai pai tong?
     Khriston' samung tangmo chouh ya le,
     Chung tre dosa maibimo kroi kha.

	Probun' samung tang ya jat bai ha le,
	Brao bai brao ni ha kchau nai;
	Ha bai jat bahchamo yarung le,
	Khriston' khupor sakhouhmo sei.

2.   Purthim ni don sompoti rao le,
     Srahha wo kmapai thanng nai;
     Khriston' khupor sanai raole,
     Jonom wo thang ye, brao thoi nai ya.

3.    Chini tongmung bai chini akol,
     Khriston' khupor se sa di;
     Khriston' mmung kaham khenai rao de?
     Bini mmung opoman khenai rao!

4.    Jisu ni kau rimo ktorr ther le,
     Khupor kaham sa mo sei;
     Purthim ha kuarma wo thanng ye se,
     Chin' Probu ni panda tanglai s'na.

5.   Ha bai jati no maiya ong khe,
     Khriston' khupor se sa di;
     Ha bai jati no maiya cha khe,
     Khriston' khupor no chouh se sa di.

title: RANGMA CHUNG KHATUNG THAOHMO (NUNNA KAN DUH BER TE HI)
RANGMA PROBU NO RI HA (NUNNA HI LALPA KA PE)
lyrics:
1.   Rangma Probu no ri ha,
     Nini yauh wo toingsi di;
     Muhphrih ksungha chouh wo pho,
     Nung no baju ni ong thou.

2.    Probu no ain' yauh ri ha,
     Nin' kau bai khosa phlai thou;
     Yakoung pho Nini samung,
     Tang yauh nai hinng tongsi thou.

3.    Khorang pho Nung no ri ha,
     Nini kau dei ongsi thou;
     Bkhu pho Nini panda sei,
     Kaugboi bai kplung ongsi thou.

4.   Aini don Nung no ri ha,
     Sisa pho ang khaohsih ya;
     Bkha Nung khatungmo dei,
     Nini kau dei khesi di.

5.   Ang khatungmo pho ri ha,
     Nini panda khesi di;
     Bkha pho Nung no yaphaih ha,
     Nin' tongthaima khesi di.

6.    Ang hiaomaimo bkha no pho,
     Nung no ang ri ni mchu ou;
     Je tongmo Nung no ri nai,
     Aini bsaoh no pho la di.

title: RAJA ACHAI JWO NI KHUM BA HA (LALPIAN HUN PANGPAR A VUL LEH TA)
lyrics:
1.   Raja achai jwo ni khum ba ha,
     Bkha wo paothu tongmo no ksa phai ha;
     Being saphlaimo Bethlehem hathai yo,
     Khathoimo bkrang bai berai ou.

	O aini Probu Nung ang no tuinang di,
	Nung mma mpha ni thing apheih dei khe;
	Nung kahmo zaga khathang ou.

2.   Uaingsouh khadou Bethlehem hathai,
     Sal hah ni moilato no houng tong ou;
     Mshu nouh ni aini Raja ksu no,
     Bini mma Mari bam tong ou.

3.   Bethlehem aiktor piphai phi ha,
     Eden hakho doka karasoing ha;
     Sra ye bahcha di Eden hor ai ha,
     Chung choungmo raijo mkhaoh thanng s'na.

4.   Groing tong khadou Raja ni ha le,
     Chin panda Bethlehem hathai pi ha;
     Ake ni mchoi-mchu rao nuhsouh yama,
     Uri khumba klai berai ou.

title: RAJA ACHAIMO SOMOI KHONDE HA (LALPIAN HUN LAWMAWM TAK KAN THLENG LEH TA)
RAJA NI MELA JAI ONGPAI HA (LALBER CHUAN RAUITHEH A PEIH TA E)
lyrics:
1.   Raja ni mela jai ongpai ha,
     Zaga tong khou tre brouh reing di;
     O toibi di Bini nouh pung gra thou,
     Kanggal houhkhoinai rao cha gra thou.

	Lam ktorr bai kaingbaihching yo thanng ye,
	Pap lama mnaohma ni bser wo;
	Thanng di, Thanng di, nung khalaomo bai,
	Sunngnaroi rao toibi di.

2.    Zaga tong khou tre kthum la phi di,
     Arpho angno baoya rao le;
     Reingmo khorang khna ya tongnai rao le,
     Tre le brao no reing yauh nai ya.

3.   Zaga tong khou tre hum la phi di,
     Isor ai nungno tho yauh ou;
     Uaingsouhmo bsing yo toisoing bi di,
     Toikhouhnaiha ni maiya wo.

4.   Uana, kanggal, gristi raon' panda,
     Sorgo wo zaga thuhsoing khou;
     Kthumlai phi di doka phunng ya khosning,
     Saohthaih ye brao no reing gra di.

5.    Sorgo mela dongka touh yauh nai,
     Raijo ktorr souhphai yauh nain' baoh ye;
     Bo ha le uana asari ong ha,
     Phai di chung pho brao no reing s'na.

6.   Doka phung ya khosning jai ong ye,
     Uana rangsung kmanai rao no;
     Brao Probu reingmo kau khnari ye,
     Mela cha ni palsaing na.

title: ROIBAR WO KHLUM YE MANE DI (CHAWLHNI LALPA KUNIN NGAI LA)
lyrics:
1.   Roibar wo khlum ye mane di,
     Ni'n nouh ni sal wo berai ou;
     Man khemo no khakchang sao di,
     Kross ni sal wo bahai mtom sa thou.

2.    Hani Robibar nung rimo,
     Souhphai khe chung khakchang lai ou;
     Ni'n brouh raoni khele him ba
     Roibar torthaoh mo sorgo wo.

3.    Aro man khemo khorang wo,
     Phola chamo khorang tre kroi;
     Roibar ni kchar wo tre sal kroi,
     Jonom se Roibar ong tong ou.

4.   Kthum nouh hing ye yre juda kroi,
     Bung so se Isor Bera bsa;
     Isor mohiman kara ou,
     Chati pho Bera bsa so sei.

5.    Roibar Probu chung khatung ou,
     Ha le ni'n temple ong nang thou,
     Tre sal pho mankhemo ni sal,
     Tangmo sari gan chanang thou.

title: RO WO THANG YAUH NAI TOI HIOL OU (HETAH HIAN NUNNA TUI A LUANG)
SALBOI JISU NO AINI BKHA WO (NI TIN ISUA KA THINLUNGIN KA HMANGAIH)
lyrics:
1.   Salboi Jisu no aini bkha wo ang maiya cha ou,
     Bung le Sal pimo ni slai pho se groing tongkuhmo sei;
     Bung le aini panda wo groingnang mchang souhmo so sei,
     Salboi yaphang ni slai Bini Groing gbaoruh gbaoruh sei.

	Baohlai pho chung sisouh ya,
	Bo toirkung wo tong ye;
	O, aro yaphang ni slai,
	Tre se naithaomo gbao nai.

2.    Hakchal wo nuhhoihmo bai phuh ang no kara hoih ou,
     Lili khum ni groing bai Aiktorma n'slai pho kara ou;
     Ang khatungmo splung ye, ang khakchangmo pho splungsouh ha,
     Salboi yaphang ni slai Bini groing gbaoruh gbaoruh sei.

3.    Aini bkha leingsouh phuh wo Bung se angno nangkhruh ou,
     Ang kosto mai tong pho Bini khlom wo angno toing ou;
     Khristo aini pap honai no se ang maiya cha ou,
     Salboi yaphang ni slai Bini groing tongruh tongruh sei.

title: SALBOI AINI THING TONGPHLAI DI (NITIN KA HNENAH AWMRENG ANG CHE LALPA)
lyrics:
1.   Salboi aini thing tongphlai di O, Probu,
     Ang pho Nini thing tong ni mlu ya;
     Khathang phuh sal wo leinglathai no phnuh di,
     Ang rchah ye tong nai uanamo chmoi bser wo.

	Khakchangmo ujangna souh phuh wo,
	Uanamo klai ye kaohlai nai rao;
	Chini Probu no pal baju lai na,
	Aro sorgo ni khumba kroih ni sal kroi.

2.    Chung khakamo sal le daidi kroih phi ou,
     O, Kalbari Nung groingnang ong di;
     Baju ye tong wanou Nini khumba no,
     Khakchang ye zaga kthar no naihoih phi nai.

3.    Yaphang chung khakamo boikhonto kma pho,
     Kalbari yo hor aiphai phi ha;
     Zion ha tongthaona no phiao yauh phi ha,
     Bahcha s'na chini panda hor ai tong ha.

4.   Taoh wo chung joto khakchanglai mi ong khe,
     Uana phuh ang khathanngmo brouh rao;
     Probu ni thing yo pal khe ye rchah yauh nai,
     Ang choung phuh sal wo khathanng souh ye tong ou.

title: SAL HAH YAMA ZION SORR KTORR (NI TLA NGAI LO ZION KHAWPUI)
lyrics:
1.   Sal hah yama Zion sorr ktorr,
     khathanng ye ang kah tong ou salboi yo;
     Rii ktorr chum ye tongpai ou udar rao,
     Ain' phola Zaga tong ou abo ha wo.

	Ang khathang ou (2)
	Zaga ktorr bai chumari ni slai pho;
	Uaingsouh nai groingnang Probu Jisu no,
	Ang nai mchu ou khasamo ham yauh nai.

2.    Groingnang sasouh mai yama no,
     Bin' thoi kthar bai ha no toikhouh phai ha;
     Ain' phola nung pho rtuh di abo no,
     Gulma deso le kroih ye thanng nai sei.

3.   Khakchang udar tongmo raijo,
     Ang souh mchu ha Probu Jisun' ha wo;
     Thoi bai surao ye phola yauh to di,
     Khamsangnai Probu Raijo khathanng ha.

title: SAL NI SLAI SE NUNG PIKUH OU (NI AI PAWHIN I ENG ZAWK E)
lyrics:
1.   Sal ni slai se Nung pikuh ou,
     O, aini Toikhouhnaiha;
     Nini uaingsouh hiaomo ni baoh,
     Aini bkha khakchang tong ou.

	Sal ni slai se Nung pikuh ou,
	Pikuh ou sal ni slai Nunng pikuh ou;
	Nini Sorgo tongthaoma wo,
	Tre le mnaohma kroi khaoh kha.

2.   Khakchangmo ang maimo rao le,
     Nini Chumari rao bai;
     Ang mai yauh naima Raijo le
     Jonom wo Nin' panda sei.

3.    O, Nini uaingsouhmo kau no,
     Ain' khe khakchang yauh nai;
     Abo Raijo tongthaoma le,
     Ain' khe ye snam yauhmo sei

4.   Jonom ang thang yauh nai kheye,
     Probu ain' saphslai thoi ha;
     Ang kongmo Nung sukhouh pai ha,
     Jonom se ang man khe nai.

title: SAL NI SLAI YO PIKUH NAIMA SE (NI AIPAWHA ENG ROPUI ZAWK CHU)
lyrics:
1.   Sal ni slai yo pikuh naima sei,
     Aini bkha wo pi ou;
     Purthimni pinaima ni slai,
     Jisu se pikuh ou.

	Hammari ni sal kara ou,
	Khakchang ye khakamo bai kploung sei;
	Probu muhkhang ang nai ksungha,
	Aini bkha khakchang tong ou.

2.   Aini bkha wo khakchang mo hiol wo,
     Probu bai pal tong khe;
     Aini bkha khakchangmo tong ou,
     Hammo ni mba kiao ha.

3.   Aini bkha wo khakchang mo tong ou,
     Asa ye baju mo;
     Taoh wo Bung hammari ri ou,
     Sorgo khakchangmung no.

title: SAL KTORR SAL LE SOUHPHAI NAI HA (NI ROPUI A LO THLENG DAWN TA)
lyrics:
1.   Sal ktorr sal le souhphai nai ha,
     Naisaomo Immanuel;
     Pap bai soitan mchem yauh naima,
     Toikhouhmo bsa rao sadin ong yauh nai.

	Arphuh wo le khaka ye ang rchah nai,
	Probu snammo jonom zaga ang pho mai nai;
	O, bari tongthao nai sei bari khaka nai sei,
	Khaka thaoh ya ye berai nai.

2.    O! brephuh wo ong nai Probu?
     Paimo ni sal nuh yauh nai;
     Bi ye Jordan ang baih mai nai,
     Nin' panda aiktor dei khe ang pi nai.

3.    Are so nou jonom Probu,
     Nung sorrkta snammo ha wo;
     Nini thoi bai Nung paimo rao,
     Aini thing yo phai pai di Nung hing ou.

4.    O! Sorrkta nung goingnang so sei,
     Nin' bsing ye mchem nai tong ou;
     Brao paimo gan kta rchah yauh nai,
     Purthim pai phnuhn' panda toisa toing ha.

title: SUNDAY SCHOOL WO THANGLAI SRA NA (SUNDAY SIKUL I KAL ANG U)
lyrics:
1.   Sunday school wo thannglai sra na,
     Joto brouh ni panda sei;
     Houhgra chrai pal hahlai tong khe,
     Broi chla rao ni panda sei.

	Phaisra di hamthaohmo,
	Chini ha wo kplouh phi thou;
	Bo so nou moilo le,
	Chini jati toisa nai.

2.    Bible pore ye choungphlai ou,
     Isor kau bai brouh ni kau;
     Jan ni choungmo jora tong ou,
     Kau kthu pho Isor ni kau.

3.    Khristo ni khupor kaham no,
     Udar ni lama phnuh mo;
     Tongmung kcham chung no phnuh ou,
     Khakchang ye thoi yauh nai pho.

title: SOITAN KILA NO SPAI YE MCHEM KHOI MAI YAUH NAI ()
lyrics:
1.   Soitan kila no spai ye mchem khoi mai yauh nai,
     Jehob' Isor Tongnaiha bai,
     Taoh wo chung no reing ye tong ou.

	Phaingnang ong ye kha kraoh khe di,
	Ta kri di, khaphang tabai di;
	Je nung thanng thing nini Isor nung bai tong nai.

2.    Phai di taoh wo Ang bai thanng s'na ang khasa ha,
     Aini bsa rao rangsungmo bai;
     Kahlaimo khorang ang khna ou.

3.    Je nung ka mo le nini ha se ong nai ha,
     Immanuel Isor chung no;
     Ang nangkhruh nai hing ye tong ou.

4.    Hinng di, thanng di, buskang bai se Halleluia,
     Yapri se di, ta pherao di;
     Sorgo Zion wo souh ya ha.

5.   Purthim manoi jeba bai pho ta phil yauh di,
     Bo le srahha bai se kma ye;
     Thanngmo ni jwo souhphai nai sei.

6.   Purthim somoi hamya wo pho jrom no soi ye,
     Aini kau no lanai rao le;
     Omor thangmo brao mai nai sei.

title: SOITAN SIPHAI NO DRAO SAO NI (SETANA RAL LIAN DO TURIN)
lyrics:
1.   Soitan siphai no drao sao ni,
     Probu ni brouh rao baihkhouh nai;
     Nin' yauh phaing bai nangkhruh ya khe,
     Brao tangmo no hawang nuh ya.

	Brao ni thing yo Nung tong phlai di,
	Kosto uana choungkhreih bser wo;
	Gulma rao gbeing ye tong pho,
	Brao ni thing yo Nung tong phlai di.

2.   Phola kmamo no toikhouh di,
     Deso manang berai khouh ye;
     Pap hakho ni brao baihkhouh nai,
     Probu brao no nung nangkhruh di.

3.   Houhkhoi toikang gulma bser wo,
     Khoikhlai ye kate yauh tong pho;
     Jromsoingnang ye rangma ri ha,
     Probu nung se khakchang sao di.

4.   Kahmo bai se maikloi saih ha,
     Kmanai no muhtoi bai rtuh ye;
     Maithuh toi ye brao pherao nai,
     Probu Nung se khakchang sao di.

title: SOMOING RANGZAUH RAO LE PAIYE THANGNAI HA (HUN HLU LEH RANGKACHAK)
SORGO GROINGNANG HIAOMO RAIJO (VAN HMUN ROPUI HMANGNAIH RAM KHI)
lyrics:
1.   Sorgo groingnang hiaomo raijo,
     Brouh kthar rao ni nouh so sei;
     Brao ni thing yo tonglai yauhnai,
     Purthim ni manoi khoi di.

	Purthim ni sal kmapai phuh wo,
	Khnangphuh wo nouh kpima wo;
	Brouh kthar rao tongmo jaga wo,
	Sorgo wo chung tong nai.

2.   Jonom ni nouh tongthaoma wo,
     Je tongnai nouhkhongha sei;
     Abo nouh wo tonglai yauh nai,
     Jatboi panji no nung ou.

3.   Udar khenai thoimo jaga,
     Hiaomo khupor salai ye;
     Jai ongyauhnai ma somoin wo,
     Bung hiamo no khathoi di.

4.   Keha keha khe hingsao khe,
     Nouhkhongha brouh kome nai;
     Hiaolaimo jonom zaga wo,
     Kthumlai srao phi mai nai de.

title: SORGO JERUSALEM KTA NO (VAN JERUSALEM THAR KHI MITHIANGHLIM TE KHAWPUI A NI)
SORGO TONGTHAOMA NO BERA YE (VAN RAM NUAM KALSAN IN)
lyrics:
1.   Sorgo thongthaomo no bera ye,
     Joto ni Raja Ktorther Jisu le;
     Kchuther ongye chini khe phai yo,
     Pap ni bsa rao no toikhouh phai ha.

	Maya gbangha Probu Jisu le,
	Bini samung tang rini mchu ou;
	Chung mainai ya samung kaham no,
	Phaidi takhu rao tanglai sna.

2.   Purthim Sorgo aing bagra hani,
     Khupor kaham samo ni kau no;
     Siya raono phrung ye baju di,
     Hingye Probu chungno kau ri ou.

3.    Chungno mthangnaiha Probu ni kau,
     Siye mane ya tatong srasti;
     Thoimo ni sal souhye tanglai sna,
     Akhe thangmo tup chung mainai sei.

title: SORGO TONGTHAO WO TOIKHOUHMO RCHAH OU (KHITA VAN HMUN NUAMAH TLAN TE AN ZAI)
lyrics:
1.   Sorgo tongthao wo toikhouh yauhmo rchah ou,
     Probun' buskang brao ni toung no bera ye;
     Purthim uanamo bai gulma laipai ha,
     Brouh kthar rao bai udar mainai rchah tong ou.

	Bera Bsa baju, yaphang Kalbari yo thoi ha,
	Bera Bsa baju, jonom panda thang phi nai sei.

2.   O, hiaomo rchah mo ni kau no pungsouh ha,
     Thaumtom rangzauh ni khuri wo pungphai ha;
     Probu thoi ye bahchaphi mo ni baoh ye,
     Isor ni thing jonom aing khe ma tongnai.

3.   Bera Bsa thoi wo toikunai bade le,
     Abo rchahmung kta keha pho rchah mai ya;
     Pap ni toikhouhnai se chungno toikhouh khe,
     Isor ni thing jonom aing khe ma tongnai.

title: SUMUNDRU DEI PURTHIM KUARMA WO (KHAWVEL TUIFINRIAT ZAUAH HIAN)
lyrics:
1.   Sumundru dei purthim kuarma,
     Uana yauhnaima lom' tong ou;
     Angno to di Toikhouhnaiha,
     Imangkha-gulma ong phuh wo.

	Probu Jisu Nung bade le,
	Sorgo wo aini tre sbo tong?
	Bo ha wo pho Nung bai ya khe,
	Tre ang khakchang yauhnaima kroi.

2.   Naidi Probu chung tongmo no,
     Gulma mnaohma rao souhphai mi;
     Khakchang tong yauhnai zaga kroi,
     Nini ha wo souh ya ha le.

3.    Ha ni uana hor mnaohma wo,
     Nini ha no naihoihri di;
     Ha ni kosto ang maimo rao,
     Khakchang ye se ang mchem mai nai.

title: SUMUNDRU DEI UAINGSOUHMA NO (TUIFINRIAT ANG KHAWNGAIHNA HA)
TAOH WO HIAOMO KTA PIMO RAIJO WO (TUNAH A THAR HMANGAIHNA ENG NUAMAH)
lyrics:
1.   Taoh wo hiaomo kta pimo Raijo wo,
     Groingnang Probun' Raijo;
     Aro khakchang yauhnai khum ba tong ou,
     Tre kroih ni sal se kroi.

	Khaka ye khnanngphuh chung kthumlai nai,
	Nouhkha ni Angel joto rao bai;
	Uanamo ha wo rangsungmo suh,
	Khnanngphuh wo ang khakchang rchah yauh nai.

2.    Ang thangksungha ni sal thanng ya ha le,
     Uanamo chmoi kroih ya;
     Khnanngphuh wo aro Raijo souhphuh wo,
     Purthim no khathanng ya.

3.    Abo sorr jila ang hinngnanng thanng khe,
     Ha bai ang kaohlai nai;
     Taoh abo khumba mtom bahaing mai ha,
     Bari tongthao nai sei.

4.    Angno Toikhouhnaiha ang hamyauh ou,
     Bini sigkason wo;
     Aingkhenai toikhouhmo rao khakchang ni,
     Halleluia, Amen.

title: TAUHNI PURTHIM NO ANG CHOUNGHOIH NAIMI (TUNLAI KHAWVEL HI KA NGAIHTUAH A)
lyrics:
1.   Tauhni Purthim no ang chounghoih nai mi,
     Brom kroi kha dou chini luli rao le;
     Jati painji sailai mo duar rao ou,
     Thungkchui kahni mchangya ong khauh ha.

	Khakhom rinai Khristo nthing ou,
	Khlumye Yasku parelai sna.
	Toikhouhnai Khristo Jisu se,
	Kangal rao ni Soyang Isor le.

2.   Saoh choungmo tor rini ang choung tongmi,
     Ujapali pho aini choungmo sei;
     Sauhkeha ni phaing no asa mo bai,
     Khakhom rinai bui angmang laya.

3.    Ha bai painji kmamo ang chounghoih mi,
     Aini rungmo simo tuikhlai bai ye;
     Hani yauhmar ktorther rao ang maipho
     Kate naislehlai mo wo sroh sei.

4.   Hani samung joto ang chounghoihmi,
     Batai laimo bloung purthim zaga sei,
     Chin takhu luli msa rao joto le,
     Kri bai khaphang mangbu khakhna dou.

title: TAOH NI ASKAL NI (TUNLAI THIL AWMZIA)
THANG DI SOMOI NAI YE TANG DI (KAL LA, I HUN ZAWNGIN THAWK LA)
lyrics:
1.   Thang di somoi nai ye tang di,
     Mpha khakchangmo dei khe tang di;
     Abo se Probu ni lama,
     Khathoinai, nungba tang ya dei?

2.    Thang ye tang di somoi tong khou,
     Krimo le sorgo souh mai ya;
     Brouh rao nung no brom toing ya pho,
     Probu se nung no toisa nai.

3.    Thanng di, tang di, tang jora sei,
     Nini bkha bsing khakchang yauh nai;
     Bini maiya no brom toing ye,
     Nung tangmo mangna thanng nai ya.

4.   Thanng di somoi yo se tang di,
     Purthimbi gulma laitao ha;
     Slehmo no khoi ye tang si di,
     Phola toikhouh yauh naima sei.

5.    Nin sam mnaoh wo brouh thoi tongmo,
     Brao ni bkha khakhom mai yauh nai;
     Homcham toi ye kara ri di,
     Mnaohma no Bung se kroihri nai.

6.   Thanng di leinghoih ya ye tang di,
     Phola kmanai no toibi di;
     Deso manang no naikhlai ye,
     Kmanai rao no toibi si di.

7.   Nung tangmo wo khakchang tong di,
     Dugu khemo mangna ong ya;
     Hainyouhbagran' khorang khna nai,
     Khorang khnasao di ang phai ha.

title: THANGKSUNGHA AIN' LAMA NO JISU (KA DAMLAI NUN KAWNG HI LAL ISU)
lyrics:
1.   Thangksungha ain' lama no Jisu,
     Hingrung yauh nai ang no phrung phai di;
     Nin' ha souh ni skang, pap se ang no,
     Stoh ye ang imang kha ye tong ou.
