	Phaing kroi rao no phaing Riphlainaiha,
	Ang pho Nin' yaphang wo phaija ou;
	Nin' Kross sakhlom wo leingma phiouhja di,
	Ang tang deramo kar ye khui di.

2.    Bkha bai ye imang kha ye tong pho,
     Nin' Phola bai srari phaiphi di;
     Phaing kroi khe ang uana ye tong pho,
     Ang no khakhom ye srari phai di.

3.    Purthim naithaomo se torr phai pho,
     Ain' khe le Nung sei Ktorther Jisu;
     Thangksungha chumari maimo rao,
     Jisu no mai min baoh bera nai.

title: THANGMO PROBU NO RI HA (NUNNA HI LALPA KA PE)
lyrics:
1.   Thangmo Probu no ri ha,
     Nini yauh wo toingsi di;
     Muhphrih ksungha chouh wo pho,
     Nung no baju ni ong thou.

2.   Byauh rao pho nungno ri ha,
     Nin' kau bai songsa phlai thou;
     Yakoung pho Nini samung,
     Tang yauh nai hinng tongsi thou.

3.   Khorang pho Nung no ri ha,
     Nini kau dei ongsi thou;
     Bkhu pho Nini panda sei,
     Kaugboi bai kplung ongsi thou.

4.   Aini don Nung no ri ha,
     Sisa pho ang khaohsih ya;
     Bkha pho Nung khatungmo dei,
     Nini kau dei khesi di.

5.   Ang khatungmo pho ri ha,
     Nini panda khesi di;
     Bkha pho Nung no yaphaih ha,
     Nin' tongthaima khesi di.

6.    Ang hiaomaimo bkha no pho,
     Nung no ang ri ni mchu ou;
     Je tongmo Nung no ri nai,
     Aini bsaoh no pho la di.

title: THANGKSUNGHA SAOHTHAIH TANGLAI SNA (DAMCHHUNGIN I THAWKTHUIA ANG U)
lyrics:
1.   Thangksungha saohthaih tanglai sna
     Pap bai gulma bser wo pho
     Khnangphuh ou toikhouhnai sal ou
     Tongktor chumari chung mainai

	O ha ni tongktor rao le
	Jonom zaga souh naiya
	Ujangna ni thangmo toung ktor le
	O toikhouhmo rao se ma hong nai

2.    Yaphang Eden bagan kthar ou
     Howa bai Adam song le
     Khaphang siya ong min' baoh ye
     Pap bai ruhkhouh hoih yauh ha

3.    Dugu bai pocha hornai rao
     Toima baih ye bera nai
     Khnang phuh ou Kanan raijo wo
     Chung uanamo rao kmapai nai.

title: THOIMO TOI LAI YE SORR KTORR GROINGNANGMA (THIHNA LUI PIAHAH KHAWPUI MAWI TAK CHU A AWM)
lyrics:
1.   Thoimo toi lai ye sorr ktorr groingnangma tong ou,
     Aro ni chumari samai ya;
     Aro wo sal thangmo bai mnaohma kroi khaoh kha,
     Abo sor groingnang tongthaoma wo.

	Raijo sal thangkhaoh ya,
	Jonom wo pimo wo;
	Brouh kthar rao se Tuikhouhnai no brom toing phlai ou,
	Abo sorr groingnang tongthaoma wo.

2.   Aro wo Probu bai Tuikhouhnaiha tongmo,
     Khathoinai rao khakchang se nuh nai;
     Jonom wo athugkhroi pimo dei brao pi nai,
     Abo sorr groingnang tongthaoma wo.

3.    Kross yaphang wo joto ni phola toibi khe,
     Bera joli bsing yo chung choh khe;
     Chini tong brom nang torri nai brao ong nai sei,
     Abo sorr groingnang tongthaoma wo.

title: THOI BAI HIOLMO TOISA TONG OU (LUI HNAR A AWM, THISEN A LUANG)
lyrics:
1.   Thoi bai hiolmo toisa tong ou (3)
     Kalbari yo hiol mo;
     Abo toi papnang raon' panda (3)
     Suraomo mai yauh nai.

	O, Kalbari toi groingnang (3)
	Aini khe ye hiol mi.

2.    Papnangha no kross beh toingmo(3)
     Surao yauh nai mai ha;
     Bung dei ang pho papnang ong pho (3)
     Ang no kthar khe mai ou.

3.    Probu Nini thoi baihkhouhmo(3)
     Si ya rao bangthaih ou;
     Surao yauhnai rao bo nuh ye (3)
     Braon pocha kma thangha.

4.   Khathoimo bai toisa nuh ha (3)
     Ain' ha souhri hiol ha;
     Bung uaingsouhmo ain kau torr ther (3)
     Ang thoi mo sal souh ye.

title: THOI MOILO THOI MOILO (THISEN HLU THISEN HLU)
TMA NI BAOH YE USOM RAO BA (ENGVANGIN NGE MIPUI TE CHU)
TMA PAP NO SURAO MAI NAI (ENGNGE SUAL TIFAI THEI ANG)
lyrics:
1.   Tma pap no surao mai nai,
     Jisu Khristo ni thoi bai sei;
     Tma chung no mthang phi mai nai,
     Jisu Khristo ni thoi bai sei.

	O, Jisu ni thoi bai,
	Chung no surao mi sei;
	Surao mai nai tre kroi,
	Jisu Khriston' thoi bai ya khe.

2.    Pap surao mai nai tre kroi,
     Jisu Khriston' thoi bai ya khe;
     Chung samung tangmo bai ya,
     Jisu Khriston' thoi bai ya khe.

3.   Mungha pho ang nang yauh ya,
     Jisu Khriston' thoi no ya khe;
     Khakchangmo ang maimo le,
     Jisu Khriston' thoi yo chouh sei.

4.   Ang khakchangmo mai mo le,
     Jisu Khriston' thoikchaoh wo sei;
     Pap ni khoma ang maimo le,
     Jisu Khristo ni thoi bai sei.

title: TINI ISORN' SAL SOUHPHAI HA (VAWIIN PATHIAN NI A LO THLENG)
lyrics:
1.   Tini Isorn' sal souhphai ha,
     Bung no baju chung kthumlai ou;
     Aichu bahcha ye puse ou,
     Chung si ou khakchang yauh naima.

2.   Chini pap khoma chung saing ou,
     Kau hamya juh chung khathoi ou;
     Chung no uaingsouhmo no choung khe,
     Ang no laruh mi lih ong ha.

3.   Chung saldouh samung tangmai ou,
     Leinghoihmo sal wo tangmai ya;
     Bung hammo bai juh gbolphai ou,
     Are ongmi Isor ni sal.

4.    Chini bkha bukchama kau wo,
     Isorn' bade ta mane thou;
     Isor kthar Bini chumari,
     Choungsi thou mai yauh nai hammo.

5.   Jisu samung kaham ri ye,
     Bung dei kau samai yauh naima;
     Probu Phola Kthar chung saing ou,
     Sorgo wo chung no toinang di.

title: TINI NO SAL (VAWIIN NI HI)
lyrics:
Tini no sal, tini no sal
	Kchuther chung no rimo (2)
	Ang baju nai, ang baju nai
	Akhe khakchang tong nai (2)
	Tini no sal Kchuther chung no rimo
	Ang baju nai akhe khakchang tong nai
	Tini no sal, tini no sal
	Kchuther chung no rimo

title: TINI SAL WO TINI BAR WO (VAWIIN NI LEH KARAH HIAN)
lyrics:
1.   Tini sal wo tini bar wo,
     Isor toibi ye malai ha;
     Nrao ni dehor bai phola rao ba,
     Krauh kaham de nrao ba tong pai,

	Chini biadi ham yauh nain' khe,
	Phai di Kalvary bkhauh bai,
	Khaphang tola khe ye sder lai na,
	Are singkhe roikhia ong nai.

2.    Chung thwu tongmo bahcha lai sna,
     Hor le aini sampha ha,
     Bosahha nungba muhtroi thao nang,
     Aichu taula dak ri nang kha.

3.   Sal chura saja ka nai ha,
     Thuthai yo ni bahcha sna,
     Horni tongmungno bera lai ye,
     Salni tongmung sazau lai sna.

title: TOIKHOUHNAIHA AINI PANDA (CHHANDAMTU CHU KA SUAL TLANIN)
lyrics:
1.   Toikhouhnaiha aini panda,
     Bo Purthim wo phai ha;
     Papi thang ni mchang ya rao dei,
     Mphang wo beh toing ha.

	O mthangnaiha Jisu thar le,
	Ain panda mai yauh ha;
	Uanamo mai ye thoi thanng ha,
	Chung no Bung toikhouh ha.

2.   Toikhouhnaiha 'Ang toikang ou',
     Hing ye Bung chrih phuh wo;
     Usom gbangma rao ni bsing yo,
     Toi mkhaingnai se kroi kha.

3.   Bung thanng mo lama no nai di,
     Kalbari hathai yo;
     Probu Nung no chung ruh raoh ya,
     Khathoinai rao hing ou.

4.    Bung uana, phola kmam phuh wo,
     Ang nangkhruh mchu tong wo,
     Nini kau dei tong ni mchu pho,
     Aini phaing le sa sei.

title: TOIKHOUHNAI BAI MALAI NI (KA CHHANDAMTU CHU TAWK TURIN)
lyrics:
1.   Ain' toikhouhnai bai malai ni
     Yauh bukcha de malai nai
     Salha pho ang rimai ya ye
     Bung no ang tma no rinai

	Toikhouhnai bai malai ni
	Yauh bukcha khe de thanng nai
	Phola keha pho toiya ye
	Ang malai nai Probu bai

2.    Thoi ni slehye ang uana ya
     Tuikhouhnai loge tong mi
     Yauh bukcha khe ye malai ni
     Uana ye ang sleh phi ou

3.   Borsi gbangma laipai mo no
     Pheraori maini ong khe
     Pherao ye udar khenai no
     Khakchang ye yaphaih nai

4.   Khathoinai joto bahcha ye
     Sal kara tongsaoh tang di
     Nrao ni rangma paiya khosning
     Phola kmanai tuikhouh di

title: TOIKHOUHNAI CHUMARI SAL WO (CHHANDAMTU I ROPUI ZARAH)
lyrics:
1.   Toikhouhnain' chumari sal wo,
     Leinghoihthaima tong wo;
     Nini phaing bai gulma joto,
     Joto zaga ni toikhouh di.

	Nini mmang chamo yaphaih di - (3)
	Bung se nungno nangkhruh tong phlai nai.

2.   Nini thing jesuh yaphaihmo,
     Nung se yachaoh phlai wo;
     Uana ye imanngkha tong pho,
     Kosto joto suh bai.

3.   Tma ang uana ye pung tong sning,
     Kosto souhphai tong pho;
     Khathoiya rao krimacha nai,
     Chung khakchangmo sal wo.

title: TOIKHOUHNAI MAIYA LIH ONGMO (CHHANDAMTU HMANGNGAIHNA MAK LEH)
lyrics:
1.   Toikhouhnai maiya lih ongmo,
     Khupor kaham man toing di;
     Bin Chumari tre bare nai,
     Jonom wo kchu ong tong nai.

	Jisu ni maiya man toing di,
	Mantoingmo khorang rao bai;
	Bini maiya thumo bai se,
	Purthim manang pungsi thou.

2.    Abo dei Hiaomo kthu ha le,
     Aini saohslai thoi thang ha;
     Joto jati rao bkha bai sei,
     Bung thoimo no man toing na.

3.    Saohthaih ye Bungno man toing di,
     Jonom Bung no man toing di;
     Jetjingzaga ha brouh rao bai,
     Khristo Maiya si yauh nai.

title: TOIKHOUHNAI NIAOMO ANG SI WO (CHHANDAMTU HMANGAIHNA KA HRIA)
lyrics:
1.   Toikhouhnai hiaomo ang si wo,
     Hiaomo are hing ye sa mai ya;
     Sorgo nching ha wo phaikhlai ye,
     Chung no hiaomo bai uaingsouh mi de?

	Are nou, aini, aini,
	Are nou, aini;
	Probu phaikhlai ha uaingsouh thaoh ya ye,
	Kross wo thoi ha, chung no toikhouh yauh nai.

2.    Bini dugu bai thoi hiolmo,
     Bung leingmo bai thoimo ang si wo;
     Je krungha wo abo ni kau,
     Bung dugu maimo no de sa yauh?

3.    Sorgo ni khupor ang si ha,
     Jisu ni brouh rao chouh se nuh nai;
     Are pho Sorgo wo zaga,
     Aini panda thir khemo de tong?

4.   Probu, ang swungmo yachaoh di,
     Nini thing bade ang bro thanng ni?
     Phola Kthar bai ang no sa di,
     Aini Sorgo bai Toikhouhnai no.

title: TOIKHOUHNAI UANAMO KALBARI KHAOH SDE YE (CHHANDAMTU LUNGNGAIHNA KALVARI LAM CHU PANIN)
lyrics:
1.   Toikhouhnai uanamo Kalbari khaoh wo sde ye,
     Phola Kthar ang no toinang toing di;
     Toikhouhnaiha no ang naimchu wo,
     Bini bswu ni toung bai dugu maimo.

	Bari sha wo ang no toikhouhmo,
	Yakoung-yauh bai mbara wo se mai yauhmo no;
	Aini khe Kross wo rangma ri ha.

2.    Salporti ang choung wo Probu thoimo zaga no,
     Khathoimo bai se ang naihoih wo;
     Pap brouh rao ni kchar wo beh yauh mo,
     'Ang toikang wo' Probu hing tong wo.

3.   Khna di, toikhouhnai uana ye rangsungmo khorang,
     'Apa, Ang no tma khenang' hing ye;
     Bung no behnai rao ni khe sa wo,
     Kross sahka wo Bung thoi ni ong phuh.

4.    Probu, brao ni khe ye Nung uanamo Kalbari,
     O, joto no toinang ye phnuh di;
     Brao ni khe Nung mai yauhmo si khe,
     Probu, Nung no baju ya youh ya.

title: UAINGSOUHMO BDU ROM YE (HMANGAIHNA HRUI VUANIN)
lyrics:
1.   Uaingsouhmo bdu rom ye,
     Khathangha toilai ye;
     Jisun' mmung bai yauh rom lai mo,
     Sorgo ni achar sei.

2.   Chini Mphan' biskang wo,
     Joto chung kthumlai ye;
     Choungmo bai asamo baohha,
     Khakchangmo bai pung ha.

3.    Chung uanamo baohha,
     Pocha nangkhruhlai ye;
     Probun' achar mane ye,
     Srabo chung mai ha.

4.    Chung joto kaohlai khe,
     Bkha le bari sa wo;
     Chung choungmo sorgo tongthao wo,
     Malai phi yauh nai sei.

title: UANA MO PAP RAO SE ANGNO KTING YE (LUNGNGAIHNA SUAL TINRENG TEN MIN HUALA)
lyrics:
1.   Uana mo pap rao se angno kting ye,
     Thoithai wo toinang ni;
     Khathoimo bai uklau naihoih ye,
     Toikhouhnai rtuhbi phai wo.

	Ang bari khakchang wo taoh so no,
	Toikhouhnai maiya nang khalaunaiha;
	Ain' phola Bung toikhouh phi ha.

2.    Khakchangmung gboi ain' bkha wo ang mai ha,
     Jisu angno rimo;
     Ha khakchangmo n'slai khakchangmung kchu,
     Sorgo khakchang mung mai ha.

3.   Bera Bsa tongmo hathai naihoih khe,
     Khakchangmo nai sao ye;
     Thoimo Jordan ang baih phuh wo le,
     Sorgo panda ang cha nai.

title: UANA  YE IMANGKHA TONG PHO (MANGANNA KA TAWHTE ZINGA)
lyrics:
1.   Uana ya imangkha tong pho,
     Kosto maiyauh ye ang tong pho;
     Ang choungsuh ye khakchang tong wo,
     Probu gona khe wo.

	Ang no gona khe wo (2)
	Nini thing ang tma no kri ni;
	Ang no gona khe wo.

2.    Thangksungha ni samung rao se,
     Ain' bkha no uanari tong pho;
     Uana ye imangkha tong pho,
     Probu gona khe wo.

3.    Dugu kosto souhphai tong pho,
     Khaukchoimo samung souhphai pho,
     Bo no si ye ang khakchang wo,
     Probu gona khe wo.

title: UAINGSOUHMO KCHU SAMAI YA MA (KHAWNGAIHNA MAK MAWI LEH DUHAWM)
lyrics:
1.   Uaingsouhmo kchu samai yama,
     Pap brouh udar maimo:
     Kma ye tong pho maiyauh phi ha,
     Nuh ya ongmo nuh ha.

2.   Kri ye baomung ang no phrung ha,
     Aini krimo roih ha;
     Bung hammo ba bsuh damnangma,
     Maiha khathoicheing phuh.

3.    Bipot kosto krimasah wo,
     Ang asuh tongbi ha;
     Bung se angno asuh drao ha,
     Sorgo pho souhri nai.

4.    Aro sal chung ye kara dei,
     Borsi saisi lai pho;
     Baju rchahmo raisa droi dei,
     Jonom wo thaohnai ya.

title: URO HATHAI WO SE KROSS MOILO KAI YAUH WO (A SAW RALTIANG TLANGAH KRAWS HLUN TAK CHU A AWM)
lyrics:
1.   Uro hathai wo se Kross moilo kai yauh wo,
     Lachimai mai yauhmo phnuhmo sei;
     Aini panda Kross le moilonangther so sei,
     Pap brouh panda brouh kaham thoi ha.

	Bo Kross no ang gbaoh ye rom tongnai,
	Thoi ye ang Bini thing souh ya ha;
	Yauh hoih ya ye kchaih khe ang rom nai,
	Toungktor moilonang ang pho mainai.

2.    Abo Kross no Purthim brouh saohkate tong pho,
     Ang le khaphang wo pao mai nai ya;
     Kchu Isor Bera Bsa Sorgo berabi ye,
     Kalbari hathai balsouh min' baoh.

3.    Kchu Isor Bsa moilo thoi kchaoh hiolmo Kross wo,
     Purthim wo moilo ang maisao wo;
     Ang pap brouh khoma bai ang no kthar khe yauh nai
     Ain' Probu Jisu mai ye thoi ha.

4.    Khathoi yauh thao bai thir khe Kross no romsra na,
     Kosto bai lachimaing choung ya ye;
     Khnangphuh wo Sorgo wo chung no thumsrao la nai,
     Jonom wo chumari chung mainai.
